scheme_name: Coconut Farming Development Scheme
description: Promotes commercial coconut farming, post-harvest copra processing, and rejuvenation of old palm groves across the islands.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on certified coconut seedlings, drip irrigation systems, and post-harvest equipment.
eligibility: Farmers owning land suitable for plantation crops in Andaman and Nicobar Islands
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office / Agriculture Demonstration Farm

scheme_name: High Yielding Programme (HYP) for Island Crops
description: Distributes high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds of paddy, pulses, and vegetables tailored to island tropical climate.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on seed mini-kits and organic plant protection inputs.
eligibility: All active farmers in North, Middle, and South Andaman, and Nicobar district
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Sub-Station / Panchayat Samiti

scheme_name: Development of Minor Irrigation & Water Harvesting Structures
description: Funds construction of individual farm ponds (Pani Jhora), dug wells, and pump sets to retain heavy rainfall for agriculture.
benefits: 50% financial grant for constructing farm ponds and installing water lifting pump sets.
eligibility: Island farmers holding agricultural land holdings
application_mode: Offline via Assistant Director of Agriculture (Soil Conservation)

scheme_name: Organic Spices Development Scheme (Arecanut, Pepper, Clove, Cinnamon)
description: Supports inter-cropping and high-density planting of spices like black pepper, nutmeg, clove, and cinnamon in coconut orchards.
benefits: Subsidized quality spice saplings plus financial grant of ₹20,000 per hectare for multi-tier cropping.
eligibility: Plantation crop farmers in Andaman & Nicobar Islands
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Outer Island Area Livelihood & Agri Grant Scheme
description: Special livelihood grant program for remote outer islands (Little Andaman, Nicobar group) to boost sustainable agriculture, cottage industry, and food security.
benefits: Community and individual grants ranging from ₹10,000 to ₹50,000 for local farming inputs and equipment.
eligibility: Residents and tribal farmers in remote/outer islands of A&N
application_mode: Offline via Deputy Commissioner / Tehsildar Office

scheme_name: Soil Conservation & Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Supports terracing, contour bunding, and lime treatment for acidic tropical soils.
benefits: Subsidized agricultural lime supply and 100% free soil testing and recommendation cards.
eligibility: Farmers owning soil-degraded or acidic farmland in the UT
application_mode: Offline via Soil Testing Laboratory / Zonal Officer

scheme_name: Island Micro-Protective Cultivation (Polyhouse/Shadenet) Scheme
description: Protects high-value crops and vegetable nurseries from heavy tropical rains using UV-stabilized shade nets and rain shelters.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for erecting poly-houses and rain-shelter structures.
eligibility: Vegetable farmers and nursery operators in A&N Islands
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Agriculture, Port Blair

scheme_name: Island Organic Farm Input & Bio-Pesticide Subsidy
description: Encourages pesticide-free organic farming across the archipelago by subsidizing bio-fertilizers, neem oil, and compost units.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy on certified bio-pesticides and organic manure distribution.
eligibility: Farmers practicing organic agriculture in A&N Islands
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Demonstration Farm

scheme_name: Subsidized Farm Power Machinery Scheme
description: Provides small weeders, brush cutters, paddy transplanters, and coconut climbing devices at subsidized prices.
benefits: 50% to 60% direct subsidy on light farm machinery suitable for hilly/island terrain.
eligibility: Individual farmers and SHGs in A&N Islands
application_mode: Offline via Engineering Wing, Agriculture Department, Port Blair

scheme_name: Promotion of Bee-Keeping (Apiculture) in Plantation Crops
description: Promotes apiculture in coconut and spice gardens to enhance crop pollination and supplement household income.
benefits: 40% subsidy on bee boxes, honey extractors, and bee colony units.
eligibility: Farmers and rural youth in A&N Islands with coconut/horticulture land
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office

scheme_name: YSR Rythu Bharosa - PM Kisan
description: Provides financial assistance to farmer families including tenant farmers to support their agricultural input costs before the sowing season.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹13,500 per year per farmer family in three installments (₹7,500 in May, ₹4,000 in October, and ₹2,000 in January).
eligibility: Cultivator landowning farmers in Andhra Pradesh
Tenant farmers belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities
Must be registered on the Navasakam portal
documents: Pattadar Passbook / CCRC (Crop Cultivator Rights Certificate)
application_mode: Online via Grama / Ward Sachivalayam Portal

scheme_name: YSR Free Crop Insurance (YSR Uchita Fasal Bima)
description: A 100% state-funded crop insurance scheme protecting farmers against crop loss due to natural calamities without requiring farmers to pay any premium.
benefits: Complete waiver of crop insurance premium; direct compensation for crop yield loss credited directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: All farmers cultivating notified crops in Andhra Pradesh
E-crop registration (e-Crop booking) is mandatory
application_mode: Automatic coverage via e-Crop booking at Rythu Bharosa Kendras (RBKs)

scheme_name: YSR Sunna Vaddi Crop Loan Scheme
description: Encourages prompt repayment of agricultural credit by providing a 100% interest subvention on short-term crop loans.
benefits: Zero-interest crop loans up to ₹1,00,000 upon timely repayment within the stipulated bank schedule.
eligibility: Farmers in Andhra Pradesh who avail short-term crop loans up to ₹1 lakh from institutional banks and repay on time
application_mode: Direct credit settlement through participating commercial/cooperative banks

scheme_name: YSR Yantra Seva Scheme
description: Establishes Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) at the Rythu Bharosa Kendra level to supply high-value agricultural machinery at subsidized rental rates.
benefits: 40% government subsidy and 50% bank loan support for purchasing machinery groups, tractors, and combine harvesters.
eligibility: Farmer groups, Rythu Mitra Groups, and SHGs registered under RBKs in Andhra Pradesh
application_mode: Online via YSR Yantra Seva App / RBK Level Processing

scheme_name: YSR Cheyutha
description: Provides direct financial assistance to women in rural farming communities to set up sustainable livestock, retail, and agri-business enterprises.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹18,750 per year (totaling ₹75,000 over 4 years) transferred directly to bank accounts.
eligibility: Women belonging to SC, ST, BC, and Minority communities aged between 45 and 60 years in Andhra Pradesh
application_mode: Online via Grama / Ward Sachivalayam

scheme_name: AP Micro Irrigation Project (APMIP)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems to improve water use efficiency, minimize soil erosion, and increase crop yields across drought-prone districts.
benefits: 100% subsidy for SC/ST farmers, 90% for small and marginal farmers, and 80% for general categories on drip and sprinkler setups.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Andhra Pradesh with access to a functional borewell or water source
application_mode: Online via APMIP Portal / RBK Centre

scheme_name: YSR Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK) Agri-Input Subsidy
description: Ensures direct supply of quality-certified seeds, fertilizers, and pesticides at subsidized rates directly at village-level centers.
benefits: 50% to 75% doorstep input subsidies on certified seeds and bio-fertilizers ordered via RBK digital kiosks.
eligibility: Registered cultivators in Andhra Pradesh using e-Crop booking at local RBKs
application_mode: In-person at local Rythu Bharosa Kendra (RBK)

scheme_name: YSR Animal Husbandry & Cattle Insurance Scheme
description: Provides financial support and livestock insurance coverage for milch cattle to secure dairy farmers against livestock mortality.
benefits: Subsidized insurance premium up to 80% and direct payouts up to ₹30,000 to ₹50,000 per insured head of cattle.
eligibility: Dairy farmers and cattle owners in Andhra Pradesh registered with local veterinary dispensaries
application_mode: Offline via Village Veterinary Assistant / RBK

scheme_name: AP Zero Budget Natural Farming (APZBNF / APCNF)
description: Encourages climate-resilient, chemical-free agriculture through community-managed natural farming practices and input grants.
benefits: Free training, bio-input preparation kits, Jeevamrutha preparation incentives, and organic certification support.
eligibility: Farmers in Andhra Pradesh committing land to chemical-free natural farming practices
application_mode: Offline via Community Resource Persons (CRPs) / RBK

scheme_name: AP Oil Palm Cultivation Mission
description: Supports crop diversification by encouraging farmers to convert traditional field crops into oil palm plantations.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹29,000 per hectare for planting material, inter-cropping support, and micro-irrigation installation.
eligibility: Farmers in designated oil palm cultivation zones in Andhra Pradesh with guaranteed water availability
application_mode: Online via Department of Horticulture AP

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Krishi Rinn Yojana
description: Provides crop loans and short-term agricultural credit to farmers at 0% effective interest rate by offering state interest subvention on top of central crop loan schemes.
benefits: 100% interest subvention (0% effective interest rate) on timely repaid agricultural crop loans up to ₹3,00,000.
eligibility: Farmers, tenant cultivators, and Self Help Groups (SHGs) involved in agriculture in Arunachal Pradesh holding Kisan Credit Cards (KCC)
application_mode: Offline via Commercial Banks / Regional Rural Banks (APStRBN) / Deputy Commissioner (DC) Office

scheme_name: Atma Nirbhar Krishi Yojana (ANKY)
description: A front-ended credit-linked subsidy scheme aimed at boosting farm mechanization, seed support, and post-harvest infrastructure for farmers across the state.
benefits: 45% Government Subsidy, 45% Bank Credit Loan, and only 10% Beneficiary Contribution for agricultural equipment and inputs.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Farmers Producer Organizations (FPOs), SHGs, and Agri-cooperatives resident in Arunachal Pradesh
documents: Bank Account Passbook and Quotation for Implements
application_mode: Online via ANKY Portal / District Agriculture Officer (DAO) Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Plantation Scheme (Kiwi, Large Cardamom & Tea)
description: Promotes high-value horticulture crops like Kiwi, Large Cardamom, Orange, and Tea by providing subsidised quality planting material and establishment grants.
benefits: Up to 50% capital and input subsidy for orchard establishment, fencing, and drip irrigation installation.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning suitable land in mid and high-altitude zones of Arunachal Pradesh
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Circle Officer

scheme_name: Atma Nirbhar Bagwani Yojana (ANBY)
description: A financial scheme designed to increase production of commercial fruits (Apple, Walnut, Kiwi, Orange) with structured bank loans and heavy state subsidies.
benefits: 45% State Subsidy + 45% Bank Loan + 10% Farmers' contribution for orchard setup and micro-irrigation equipment.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and registered horticulture cooperatives in Arunachal Pradesh
application_mode: Online / Offline via District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister Krishi Sa-Sajuli Yojana
description: Provides direct financial assistance to small and marginal farmers for purchasing farm tools and scientific equipment to enhance farm productivity.
benefits: One-time financial grant of ₹5,000 transferred directly to the farmer's bank account for purchasing agricultural implements.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing in Assam owning cultivable land up to 15 bighas (approx. 2 hectares)
Tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and farm workers with active agricultural practice
documents: Land Holding Certificate / Dag-Patta Copy or Land Ownership Self-Declaration
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) / Block Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister Samagra Gramya Unnayan Yojana (CMSGUY) - Tractor Distribution
description: Distributes high-power tractor units to selected farmer groups in every revenue village to accelerate double-cropping and farm mechanization.
benefits: 70% capital subsidy (up to ₹5,50,000) on tractor units with accessories, 20% covered by bank loan, and 10% contributed by the group.
eligibility: Selected farmer groups / Self-Help Groups consisting of 8 to 10 active farmers per village in Assam
documents: Land Holding Documents of Group Members
application_mode: Offline via District Agriculture Officer (DAO) / CMSGUY Society

scheme_name: Assam Millet Mission (AMM)
description: Encourages millet production across rainfed regions by providing seed kits, technical support, processing infrastructure, and market linkages.
benefits: Financial incentives up to ₹12,000/hectare spread across three years, free high-yield seed kits, and micro-processing machinery grants.
eligibility: Farmers in designated project blocks of Assam taking up millet (Ragi, Foxtail, Proso) cultivation
application_mode: Offline via ADO Office / APART Project Officers

scheme_name: Assam Micro Irrigation Scheme (Per Drop More Crop - PMKSY)
description: Subsidizes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) to maximize water use efficiency for horticultural crops and tea estates.
benefits: 80% to 90% subsidy on installation costs of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for small and marginal farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning or leasing land in Assam with an assured water source (tube well, pond, river)
application_mode: Online / Offline via District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Assam State Crop Insurance Scheme (Mukhya Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana)
description: Protects farmers against severe crop failure caused by floods, heavy rain, dry spells, and pest attacks.
benefits: 100% premium cost subsidized by the state government for non-loanee farmers; direct bank transfer for crop loss compensation.
eligibility: All farmers (owner-cultivators and tenant farmers) in Assam growing notified crops like paddy, jute, and oilseeds
documents: Sowing Certificate from Village Headman (Gaon Burha) / ADO
Land Patta Copy or Lease Agreement
application_mode: Offline via Local Agriculture Extension Officer / CSCs

scheme_name: Small Tea Growers Support Scheme (Assam)
description: Offers technical guidance, subsidized fertilizers, tea garden machinery, and green leaf price monitoring to small tea growers.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy on tea plucking machines, pruning tools, transport vehicles, and free soil testing services.
eligibility: Small tea growers in Assam holding up to 10.12 hectares of land registered with the Directorate of Tea
Must hold a valid Small Tea Grower identity card
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Tea / Tea Board Development Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Free Seed Distribution Scheme
description: Distributes high-yielding and flood-tolerant crop seeds (like Sali paddy, Boro paddy, and pulses) ahead of cropping seasons.
benefits: 100% free distribution of certified high-yielding and climate-resilient seed minikits directly to registered farmers.
eligibility: Small, marginal, and flood-affected farmers residing in Assam
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) / Gram Panchayat

scheme_name: Gharua Pukhuri Janasanchay Scheme (Farm Pond Development)
description: Provides support for constructing small individual farm ponds for rainwater harvesting, fish farming, and supplementary crop irrigation.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹50,000 for excavating new ponds or re-excavating existing water storage bodies.
eligibility: Individual farmers and rural households in Assam with sufficient land for pond construction
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO) / Block Office

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Animal Husbandry & Dairy Livelihood Scheme
description: Encourages rural self-employment by assisting smallholders and SHGs in establishing small dairy farms and goat farming units.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on purchasing high-yielding crossbred cows or goats, plus subsidized cattle feed and veterinary cover.
eligibility: Individual rural youth, women SHGs, and small agricultural workers in Assam
application_mode: Offline via Veterinary Officer / Block Level Animal Husbandry Office

scheme_name: Assam Silk & Eri/Muga Sericulture Mission
description: Supports traditional Muga, Eri, and Mulberry silk growers with host plant plantation grants, rearing house construction, and modern appliances.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹35,000 for constructing rearing houses, free saplings/disease-free layings (DFLs), and motorized spinning wheels.
eligibility: Traditional silkworm rearers, weavers, and farmers engaged in sericulture in Assam
documents: Sericulture Farmer Card / Land Patta Document
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Sericulture / Local Extension Officer

scheme_name: Makhana Vikas Yojana
description: Promotes high-yielding foxnut (Makhana) cultivation, field expansion, and modern post-harvest processing infrastructure across eastern Bihar.
benefits: Up to 75% subsidy (max ₹72,750/hectare) for high-yield seeds and field expansion; up to ₹16,575 grant for processing toolkits.
eligibility: Farmers owning or leasing land/waterbodies from 0.25 to 10 acres in notified Makhana districts of Bihar
Must be registered on the Bihar DBT Agriculture Portal
application_mode: Online via Bihar Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: Bihar Rajya Fasal Sahayata Yojana (BRFSY)
description: Replaces traditional crop insurance by offering completely premium-free financial compensation to farmers suffering crop loss from floods, drought, or hail.
benefits: Direct payout of ₹7,500/hectare for yield loss up to 20%, and ₹10,000/hectare for yield loss exceeding 20% (up to 2 hectares).
eligibility: Owner-farmers and non-ryot (tenant) farmers in Bihar cultivating notified crops
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Self-Declaration for Tenant Farmers
application_mode: Online via Cooperative Department / DBT Bihar Portal

scheme_name: Bihar Diesel Anudan Yojana
description: Provides financial fuel subsidies to offset high irrigation costs incurred by farmers relying on diesel pump sets during dry spells.
benefits: Subsidy of ₹75 per liter of diesel (up to ₹750/acre per irrigation cycle, max 3 cycles depending on crop type).
eligibility: Registered farmers in Bihar operating diesel-powered irrigation pump sets
documents: Valid Diesel Purchase Receipt from authorized fuel pump
application_mode: Online via Bihar DBT Agriculture Portal

scheme_name: Bihar Krishi Yantra Subsidy Scheme
description: Offers capital subsidies on over 80 types of modern agricultural machinery to accelerate farm mechanization across the state.
benefits: Direct financial subsidy ranging from 40% to 80% on tractors, threshers, combine harvesters, and zero-till seed drills.
eligibility: Registered farmers or custom hiring center operators in Bihar possessing valid Kisan Registration
application_mode: Online via OFMAS Bihar Portal

scheme_name: Bihar Beej Gram & Seed Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides high-quality, certified high-yielding variety (HYV) seeds of paddy, wheat, pulses, and oilseeds at heavily subsidized rates.
benefits: 50% to 90% subsidy on certified seeds with optional direct home delivery service.
eligibility: Registered farmers in Bihar applying through the official seed portal
application_mode: Online via BRBN Bihar Portal / DBT Agriculture

scheme_name: Bihar Micro Irrigation Scheme
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems to optimize water use efficiency in fruit, vegetable, and field crop production.
benefits: 80% to 90% grant on installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation units.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with a verified water source (borewell/pond) in Bihar
application_mode: Online via Bihar Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: Bihar Organic Corridor Scheme (Jaivik Koridor Yojana)
description: Establishes a dedicated green agricultural belt along 13 districts adjoining the Ganga river to produce certified organic crops.
benefits: Advance financial grant of ₹11,500/acre in the first year for organic inputs, free organic certification, and vermicompost support.
eligibility: Farmers holding cultivable land in designated organic corridor clusters along the Ganges
application_mode: Online via Bihar DBT Agriculture / Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: Bihar Mushroom Vikas Yojana
description: Encourages mushroom cultivation and spawn production units to provide supplementary income for landless workers and smallholders.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for establishing mushroom spawn manufacturing units, compost preparation, and growing kits.
eligibility: Individual farmers, landless agricultural workers, and women SHGs in Bihar
application_mode: Online via Directorate of Horticulture Bihar

scheme_name: Bihar Special Horticulture Development Mission
description: Drives commercial fruit production by subsidizing high-density plantations of dragon fruit, papaya, banana, and tissue-culture crops.
benefits: Up to 50% subsidy on saplings, drip line integration, and field maintenance costs spread over 3 years.
eligibility: Landholders owning minimum 0.1 hectare dedicated cultivable land in Bihar
application_mode: Online via Bihar Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Dairy Vikas Yojana (Bihar)
description: Encourages dairy entrepreneurship and self-employment by assisting in purchasing milch cattle and modern dairy equipment.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing 2, 4, or 10 milch cows/buffaloes, plus subsidy on chaff cutters and milking units.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Bihar aged 18 to 55 years setting up dairy units
application_mode: Online via Bihar Animal Husbandry Portal

scheme_name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi (Chandigarh UT)
description: Provides financial income support to landholding peri-urban farmer families in the peripheral villages of Chandigarh UT to meet agricultural input costs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Landholding farmer families possessing cultivable agricultural land in UT villages.
Must have a valid Aadhaar-seeded bank account and completed e-KYC verification.
application_mode: Online via PM-KISAN Portal (pmkisan.gov.in) / UT Agriculture Dept

scheme_name: PM Street Vendor’s AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi - Chandigarh)
description: Provides working capital loans to urban street vendors and micro-traders in Chandigarh to restart and expand their informal businesses post-pandemic.
benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹50,000 in tranches with 7% interest subsidy and cashback incentives on digital transactions.
eligibility: Urban street vendors operating in Chandigarh prior to March 2020 or possessing Certificate of Vending.
Vending ID card issued by Municipal Corporation Chandigarh (MCC).
documents: Vending ID / Letter of Recommendation from MCC
application_mode: Online via PM SVANidhi Portal / Sampark Centres

scheme_name: Chandigarh Urban Agriculture & Terrace Gardening Initiative
description: Promotes micro-farming, kitchen gardening, and rooftop organic cultivation across residential sectors and rural fringes under the Greening Chandigarh campaign.
benefits: Free organic seed kits, subsidized saplings, rooftop farming toolkits, and free training workshops conducted by UT Horticulture Division.
eligibility: Residents of Chandigarh (Urban & Rural sectors).
Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs) and educational institutions.
documents: Application Form available at UT Nursery/Horticulture Dept
application_mode: Offline via Government Nurseries / Department of Horticulture

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme - UT Chandigarh
description: Provides short-term revolving credit to farmers, dairy owners, and poultry growers in peripheral sectors of Chandigarh at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3 lakh to ₹5 lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (after 3% prompt repayment subvention).
eligibility: Farmers, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers cultivating land in Chandigarh UT.
Individuals engaged in animal husbandry, dairy farming, or fisheries in UT villages.
documents: Land Possession Certificate or Livestock Possession Proof
application_mode: Offline through commercial banks / Lead District Bank Office Chandigarh

scheme_name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme (Chandigarh UT Branch)
description: Provides end-to-end support to traditional artisans and craftspeople in Chandigarh including carpenters, blacksmiths, armorers, and potters.
benefits: Free skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 toolkit incentive, and collateral-free loans up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest rate.
eligibility: Resident artisans of Chandigarh practicing one of the 18 eligible traditional trades.
Minimum age of 18 years; restricted to one family member.
application_mode: Online via PM Vishwakarma Portal or e-Sampark Centres

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY - UT Sector)
description: Comprehensive yield risk coverage for food crops, oilseeds, and horticultural crops grown in Chandigarh against natural disasters and pests.
benefits: Insurance payout based on crop damage; nominal premium of 1.5% for Rabi, 2% for Kharif, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers (loanee and non-loanee) growing notified crops in Chandigarh UT.
application_mode: Online via National Crop Insurance Portal (pmfby.gov.in) / Banks

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - UT UT Division)
description: Supports peri-urban cultivators in Chandigarh with subsidies to purchase micro-cultivators, power tillers, sprayers, and shredders suitable for small acreage.
benefits: Financial subsidy ranging from 40% to 50% on cost of approved agricultural machinery.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing and cultivating in UT Chandigarh.
Priority given to SC/ST and women farmers.
application_mode: Online via Agrimachinery Portal / UT Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Soil Health Card Scheme - UT Chandigarh
description: Regular testing of agricultural soil samples across Chandigarh's rural belts to give customized crop-wise nutrient recommendations.
benefits: Free Soil Health Card detailing 12 critical soil parameters (macro/micro nutrients) and macro-fertilizer dosage advisory.
eligibility: All land-owning and cultivating farmers in UT Chandigarh.
application_mode: Offline sample collection driven by UT Agriculture Department

scheme_name: Chandigarh SC/ST/BPL Free Bus Pass & Welfare Subsidy
description: UT-funded social relief initiative giving free and concessional public transportation passes via Chandigarh Transport Undertaking (CTU) to vulnerable groups.
benefits: Free annual/monthly travel passes across CTU local routes for SC/ST, BPL residents, students, and senior citizens.
eligibility: Domicile/Permanent residents of Chandigarh UT.
BPL cardholders, registered SC/ST candidates, or senior citizens aged 60+.
application_mode: Online via e-Sampark Portal / CTU Bus Stand Counters

scheme_name: National Livestock Mission - Chandigarh UT Chapter
description: Encourages sustainable livestock management, backyard poultry, and fodder development in UT villages to enhance supplemental rural income.
benefits: Up to 50% capital subsidy on poultry development, goat rearing units, and disease prevention vaccination.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and joint liability groups operating within UT Chandigarh limits.
application_mode: Online via NLM Portal / UT Animal Husbandry Office

scheme_name: Krishak Unnati Yojana
category: Input Cost Assistance / Paddy Procurement Support
description: A flagship state scheme providing input assistance and price support to paddy farmers in Chhattisgarh, ensuring remunerative returns and enhancing agricultural productivity.
benefits: Financial assistance through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) calculated per acre to cover differential paddy input costs, guaranteeing substantial income payout per quintal.
eligibility: Farmers registered on the CG Unified Farmer Portal (Kisan Portal).
Cultivators (owners and registered tenant farmers) selling paddy through Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS).
application_mode: Online via Unified Kisan Portal (kisan.cg.nic.in)

scheme_name: Deendayal Upadhyay Bhoomihin Krishi Majdoor Kalyan Yojana
description: Provides direct cash assistance to landless agricultural labourer families, rural artisans, and traditional priests in Scheduled areas across Chhattisgarh to support their living standards.
benefits: Annual cash benefit of ₹10,000 paid directly to the bank account in installments.
eligibility: Domicile of Chhattisgarh.
Rural landless families dependent primarily on agricultural labor.
Traditional priests (Baiga, Gunia, Manjhi, Haat Pahariya) in tribal areas without landholding.
documents: Landless Declaration Certificate verified by Tehsildar/Gram Panchayat
application_mode: Online / Offline via Gram Panchayat or Revenue Portal

scheme_name: Saur Sujala Yojana
description: Implemented by CREDA under the Energy Department, providing highly subsidized solar-powered water pumping systems to farmers for reliable irrigation in non-electrified off-grid agricultural zones.
benefits: Subsidized 3 HP and 5 HP solar pumps provided at a nominal fraction (5% to 10%) of the total equipment cost.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of Chhattisgarh with agricultural land.
Fields located in areas lacking regular electrical grid connections.
Assured ground/surface water source.
application_mode: Offline via CREDA District Offices / Agriculture Department

scheme_name: Shakambhari Yojana
description: Provides financial subsidy to small and marginal farmers for digging open wells and installing diesel/electric/solar pump sets for crop diversification and micro-irrigation.
benefits: Up to 75% subsidy on irrigation pumps and up to 50% subsidy on open well construction cost.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers possessing up to 2 hectares of land.
Prioritization given to SC, ST, and women farmers.
application_mode: Offline via Senior Agriculture Development Officer (SADO)

scheme_name: CG Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana (State Top-Up)
description: A state supplement scheme that offers additional annual financial top-ups to small and marginal farmers enrolled in PM-KISAN within Chhattisgarh.
benefits: Additional ₹6,000 per year paid in installments directly into bank accounts (bringing combined annual benefit to ₹12,000 when paired with PM-KISAN).
eligibility: Resident farmers of Chhattisgarh.
Must be an active, verified beneficiary of PM-KISAN.
Aadhaar-seeded bank account with completed e-KYC.
application_mode: Automatic inclusion for PM-KISAN verified farmers / Gram Panchayat Agri Office

scheme_name: Krishi Yantra Seva Kendra (Farm Machinery Banks)
description: Incentivizes rural youth and agricultural cooperatives to set up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs) to rent out heavy farm machinery (tractors, harvesters, rotavators) at affordable rates to smallholders.
benefits: Capital subsidy of up to 40% (max ₹10 lakh to ₹25 lakh depending on unit capacity) on machinery unit establishment.
eligibility: Rural youth, self-help groups (SHGs), Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), or individual farmers in Chhattisgarh.
Age between 18 and 45 years for individual entrepreneurs.
application_mode: Online via Agriculture Engineering Portal / SADO Office

scheme_name: Jaivik Kheti Mission (Organic Farming Mission Chhattisgarh)
description: Promotes 100% organic farming practices in designated tribal districts (such as Dantewada, Sukma, Bijapur, Bastar, Surguja) to reduce synthetic chemical dependency.
benefits: Distribution of free organic seed kits, bio-fertilizers, vermicompost units support, and free Organic Certification under Participatory Guarantee System (PGS).
eligibility: Farmers operating in notified organic districts/blocks of Chhattisgarh.
Individual or cluster farmer groups committing to 3-year organic conversion.
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Kisan Samriddhi Yojana
description: Provides financial aid for borewell drilling and installation of energised pumps in areas with viable groundwater, increasing double-cropped acreage.
benefits: Subsidy ranging from ₹25,000 to ₹43,000 based on farmer category (General, OBC, SC/ST) for tube well drilling and pump installation.
eligibility: All landholding farmers in Chhattisgarh.
Priority given to SC/ST and small/marginal farmers with no prior tube well subsidy.
application_mode: Offline via Office of Senior Agricultural Development Officer

scheme_name: Dr. Khoobchand Baghel Krishak Ratna Award & Incentives
description: An annual state award and incentive program honoring innovative farmers in Chhattisgarh who demonstrate breakthrough techniques in crop yield, water conservation, and integrated farming.
benefits: State-level recognition certificate along with a cash award of ₹1,00,000.
eligibility: Individual progressive farmers of Chhattisgarh.
Demonstrated record of adopting innovative, sustainable, or high-yield agricultural practices.
documents: Detailed report of agricultural innovation/yield statistics
application_mode: Offline nomination through District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Chhattisgarh Dairy Samagra Vikas Yojana
description: Focuses on boosting milk production across Chhattisgarh by supporting dairy unit setup, indigenous cow breed conservation, and fodder cultivation.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on purchasing 2 to 10 high-yielding milch cows/buffaloes, construction of modern cattle sheds, and chaff cutter purchases.
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural women, and dairy cooperatives in Chhattisgarh.
Must possess land/space for cattle shelter and fodder growth.
application_mode: Offline via Veterinary Assistant Surgeon / District Animal Husbandry Office

scheme_name: Free/Subsidized Paddy & High-Yielding Seed Distribution Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Distributes high-yielding paddy, pulse, and oilseed varieties to tribal and small farmers prior to Kharif and Rabi seasons.
benefits: 100% subsidy for SC/ST small farmers and 50% subsidy for general farmers on certified seed kits.
eligibility: Farmers, especially ST/SC cultivators in Silvassa, Daman, and Diu
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office / District Panchayat
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Subsidized Chemical & Organic Fertilizer Distribution Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Ensures affordable supply of bio-fertilizers, bacterial culture, and soil conditioners for crop fields.
benefits: Subsidized rates for fertilizer bags and organic bacterial culture kits.
eligibility: Resident farmers in UT Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Offline via Department of Agriculture, Silvassa / Daman
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Chickoo & Horticultural Fruit Plantation Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Promotes high-yielding orchards like Chickoo, Mango, and Coconut with plant saplings, fencing, and drip irrigation grants.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on fruit saplings, soil preparation, and drip setup.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in the UT
application_mode: Offline via Soil Conservation & Horticulture Department
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Subsidized Power Tiller & Farm Equipment Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Subsidizes modern farm machinery such as small tractors, weeders, power tillers, and spray pumps.
benefits: 50% subsidy (up to ₹50,000 for mini equipment and ₹1,500,000 for tractors) for eligible farmers.
eligibility: Individual farmers and farmer groups in DNH and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office, Moti Daman / Silvassa
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Drip & Micro-Irrigation Assistance Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Financial assistance to convert flood irrigation into drip/sprinkler systems for water conservation.
benefits: Up to 70% subsidy on installation of micro-irrigation pipelines and emitters.
eligibility: Farmers having assured irrigation borewells or farm ponds
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture Office
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Soil Health Card & Soil Conservation Works Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Carries out soil levelling, field bunding, soil testing, and distribution of micronutrients to prevent erosion.
benefits: Free soil testing and 50% subsidy on field bunding and soil reclamation inputs.
eligibility: Cultivators in rural areas of DNH, Daman, and Diu
application_mode: Offline via Soil Conservation Officer, Silvassa / Daman
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Subsidized Greenhouse & Poly-Net House Scheme
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Encourages cultivation of off-season vegetables and cut flowers under controlled polyhouse environments.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for polyhouse and shade-net construction.
eligibility: Individual farmers and horticulturists in the UT
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Organic Vermicompost Unit Setup Subsidy
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Provides cash grants for constructing permanent vermicompost pits and procuring earthworm cultures.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per vermicompost unit.
eligibility: Farmers adopting organic farming practices in the UT
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Agri-Stack & Digital Farmer Identity Program
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Creates a unified digital registry (AgriStack) for seamless distribution of government crop subsidies, direct benefit transfers, and insurance claims.
benefits: Direct access to single-window subsidized seeds, fertilizers, and instant DBT relief.
eligibility: All landholding and tenant farmers in Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Online / Offline via District e-Governance / Agriculture Stack Counters
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Plant Protection Equipment & Pesticide Subsidy
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
description: Provides battery-operated knapsack sprayers and bio-pesticides at concessional rates to protect crops from pest outbreaks.
benefits: 50% subsidy on battery sprayers and eco-friendly bio-pesticide formulations.
eligibility: Active crop growers in DNH and Daman & Diu
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agriculture Office
_scope_name: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

scheme_name: Delhi Urban Farming & Rooftop Gardening Initiative
description: A flagship initiative by the Delhi Government to promote organic rooftop gardening, balcony micro-farming, and backyard vegetable cultivation across residential colonies and urban clusters in Delhi.
benefits: Free urban farming DIY kits, hands-on training workshops by horticulture experts, distribution of native seeds, organic compost, and technical support for vertical garden setups.
eligibility: Must be a resident of NCT of Delhi.
Individuals, Resident Welfare Associations (RWAs), schools, or local community groups.
Access to adequate open space (rooftop, balcony, or backyard) with sunlight.
documents: Proof of Residence in Delhi (Electricity Bill / Voter ID)
application_mode: Online / Offline via Environment & Forest Dept

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY) - Delhi Region
description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming in Delhi's rural and peri-urban belts (such as Najafgarh, Alipur, and South West Delhi) through cluster-based approaches and Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, seeds, bio-fertilizers, cluster formation, packaging, and branding.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in rural/peri-urban villages of Delhi.
Group of 20 or more farmers forming an organic farming cluster of 50 acres.
Willingness to adopt 100% organic techniques under PGS guidelines.
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Extension Office

scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH) - Delhi
description: Provides financial assistance to farmers in Delhi for setting up protected cultivation structures like shade net houses, polyhouses, and hi-tech nurseries for high-value floriculture and vegetable crops.
benefits: 50% to 60% credit-linked capital subsidy for polyhouse construction, drip fertigation systems, and high-quality plant nursery infrastructure.
eligibility: Individual farmers, FPOs, or agri-entrepreneurs in Delhi rural/peri-urban zones.
Must have clear title to land or registered lease agreement for minimum 10 years.
Assured source of irrigation at the project site.
documents: Land Records (Khasra/Khatoni) or Registered Lease Deed
application_mode: Online via MIDH / e-District Delhi Portal

scheme_name: Soil Health Card Scheme - NCT of Delhi
description: A government scheme to sample and analyze soil samples across Delhi's agricultural pockets to provide micro-nutrient status and customized fertilizer recommendations to farmers.
benefits: Free soil testing covering 12 critical parameters (N, P, K, pH, EC, Organic Carbon, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, B) and personalized crop-wise soil health cards.
eligibility: All farmers operating agricultural land within the NCT of Delhi.
application_mode: Offline via Village Agri-Extension Officer / District Labs

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Micro Irrigation Delhi
description: Focuses on 'More Crop Per Drop' by incentivizing water-saving technologies like drip and sprinkler irrigation systems for crops and orchards in Delhi's peri-urban agricultural belts.
benefits: 45% to 55% subsidy on the total cost of installing micro-irrigation systems (drip/sprinkler) connected to farm tube wells or water storage structures.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land or long-term lease holders in Delhi.
Functional water source (borewell/pond) with pump set.
application_mode: Online via District Administration Portal

scheme_name: Agri-Clinics and Agri-Business Centres (ACABC) - Delhi Region
description: Supports agricultural graduates and diploma holders in Delhi to set up commercial agri-ventures, expert advisory centers, custom hiring centers, and soil testing labs.
benefits: 45 days of free residential training, plus capital subsidy up to 36% (44% for SC/ST/Women) on bank loans up to ₹20 lakh for individual projects.
eligibility: Graduates or diploma holders in Agriculture, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, or allied sciences.
Age above 18 years residing or operating in NCT of Delhi.
application_mode: Online via MANAGE Portal

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF) - Delhi
description: Financing facility for building post-harvest management infrastructure such as cold storages, pack houses, assaying units, and sorting/grading hubs in Delhi's wholesale and peri-urban markets.
benefits: 3% per annum interest subvention on bank loans up to ₹2 crore for a maximum period of 7 years, alongside credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, Agri-Entrepreneurs, and Startups registered in Delhi.
application_mode: Online via AIF Portal

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Delhi
description: Promotes modern, eco-friendly farm machinery like happy seeders, rotavators, electric tillers, and crop residue management equipment among farmers in Delhi to curb stubble burning.
benefits: Financial subsidy of 40% to 50% on individual machinery purchases or up to 80% for setting up Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and user groups operating in Delhi's farming villages.
Priority given to small and marginal farmers.
application_mode: Online via FARMECH Portal

scheme_name: Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY) - Delhi UT Chapter
description: Provides flexible funding to Delhi's agriculture and animal husbandry departments to execute high-impact local interventions like hydroponics promotion, peri-urban mushroom cultivation, and dairy extension.
benefits: Financial assistance and grants up to 50% for specialized projects in hydroponics, vertical farming units, apiculture (beekeeping), and mushroom spawning.
eligibility: Farmers, self-help groups, and agri-entrepreneurs located in Delhi.
Must undergo mandatory technical training organized by the Department.
application_mode: Offline via Development Department, Govt of NCT Delhi

scheme_name: Livestock Health & Dairy Development Scheme - Delhi
description: Provides preventive healthcare, door-step artificial insemination, free vaccination drives, and fodder development support for cattle and dairy livestock reared in Delhi's rural and gaushala belts.
benefits: Free door-step veterinary health care services, free foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccinations, subsidized high-yielding fodder seeds, and artificial insemination kits.
eligibility: Dairy farmers, cattle rearers, and registered Gaushalas located within Delhi NCT boundaries.
application_mode: Offline via Government Veterinary Hospitals / Dispensaries in Delhi

scheme_name: Shetkari Adhar Yojana (SAY)
description: Provides financial compensation to farmers during severe crop loss caused by natural calamities, wildlife damage, or unseasonal weather.
benefits: Financial assistance ranging from ₹20,000 to ₹1,00,000 per hectare depending on the crop and extent of damage.
eligibility: Farmers residing in Goa with registered agriculture land or Krishi Card
Cultivators of paddy, sugarcane, cashew, coconut, spices, and vegetables
documents: Land Ownership Document (Form I & XIV) / Lease Deed
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO)

scheme_name: Assistance for Fencing / Crop Protection Scheme
description: Offers subsidy for constructing perimeter fencing (solar, chain-link, or bio-fencing) to protect crops from wild animals like wild boars and stray cattle.
benefits: 75% to 90% subsidy on total cost of chain-link, stone masonry, or solar fencing installation.
eligibility: Individual farmers, farmer groups, or tenant farmers holding Krishi Card in Goa
documents: Form I & XIV / Land Record Copy
Estimate and Invoice from Approved Vendor
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO)

scheme_name: Cashew Rejuvenation & Plantation Scheme
description: Encourages cashew cultivation by offering subsidies for fresh cashew planting, high-yielding graft varieties, and rejuvenating old unproductive cashew orchards.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹40,000 per hectare for planting high-yielding cashew grafts and maintaining orchards.
eligibility: Goan farmers owning land suitable for cashew cultivation holding a Krishi Card
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO)

scheme_name: Organic Farming & Vermicomposting Subsidy Scheme
description: Promotes eco-friendly agricultural practices by subsidizing the construction of organic manure units, vermicompost units, and organic certification.
benefits: 50% subsidy up to ₹50,000 for constructing permanent vermicompost units and purchasing organic inputs.
eligibility: Registered Goan farmers practicing or adopting organic farming methods
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO)

scheme_name: Assistance for Agricultural Machinery & Implements (Mechanization)
description: Provides capital subsidies to purchase tractors, power tillers, brush cutters, weeders, and paddy transplanters to address labor shortage.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on cost of agricultural machinery (up to ₹2,50,000 per machine depending on category).
eligibility: Krishi Card holding farmers and Registered Farmers' Clubs/Self Help Groups in Goa
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO)

scheme_name: Goa Paddy Cultivation Incentive Scheme (Assured Price Support)
description: Provides an assured minimum support price/incentive for paddy produced and sold by local farmers to government-designated procurement agencies.
benefits: Direct incentive bonus over MSP (up to ₹20–₹25 per kg) credited straight to the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Paddy growers in Goa holding a valid Krishi Card and registered with ZAO
documents: Paddy Procurement Receipt / Crop Sowing Certificate from ZAO
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office / Procurement Centers

scheme_name: Dairy Cattle Induction & Kamdhenu Scheme
description: Supports livestock farmers in purchasing crossbred cows and high-yielding buffaloes to make Goa self-sufficient in milk production.
benefits: Subsidy ranging from 80% to 90% of the cost of crossbred cows/buffaloes (up to 10 animals per beneficiary), including transport and insurance.
eligibility: Residents of Goa for at least 5 years engaged in or starting dairy farming
application_mode: Offline via Department of Animal Husbandry & Veterinary Services (AHVS)

scheme_name: Community Borewell & Micro Irrigation Scheme
description: Assists groups of farmers in constructing community borewells, open wells, and installing micro-irrigation systems in water-scarce zones.
benefits: 75% to 90% financial grant for drilling borewells, pump set setup, and drip/sprinkler pipeline installation.
eligibility: Group of at least 3 to 5 farmers owning adjoining cultivable lands in Goa holding Krishi Cards
documents: Krishi Cards of All Group Members
Form I & XIV of Adjoining Plots
application_mode: Offline via Zonal Agricultural Office (ZAO)

scheme_name: Financial Assistance for Brackish Water / Freshwater Aquaculture
description: Encourages fish, crab, and shrimp farming in brackish water estuaries and freshwater ponds across coastal and inland areas.
benefits: 40% to 60% capital subsidy for pond construction, seed purchase, feed, and aeration equipment.
eligibility: Inland fishers, youth entrepreneurs, and SHGs in Goa holding suitable waterbodies or land
documents: Land Record / Lease Deed of Water Body
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Fisheries, Panaji

scheme_name: Cultivation of High Value / Protected Crops in Polyhouse
description: Promotes modern protected cultivation of orchids, anthuriums, exotic vegetables, and capsicum using polyhouses and shade-net structures.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on polyhouse/shade-net structure construction costs and quality planting material.
eligibility: Individual progressive farmers or farmer producer organizations (FPOs) in Goa with valid Krishi Card
application_mode: Offline via State Horticulture Corporation / ZAO

scheme_name: Ikhedut Portal Assistance Schemes (Subsidized Farm Machinery)
description: Provides financial assistance for purchasing agricultural equipment such as tractors, power tillers, rotavators, multi-crop threshers, and seed drills to reduce labor dependency.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy on approved farm machinery (up to ₹60,000–₹1,00,000 depending on the implement and category).
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in Gujarat registered on the Ikhedut portal
Small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, and women farmers receive higher subsidy percentages
application_mode: Online via Ikhedut Portal (ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in)

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Kisan Sahay Yojana (MMKSY)
description: A state-funded crop protection scheme offering financial compensation without any premium payment by farmers in cases of drought, excessive rainfall, or unseasonal heavy rains.
benefits: Compensation of ₹20,000/hectare for crop loss between 33% and 60% (up to 4 hectares), and ₹25,000/hectare for crop loss above 60% (up to 4 hectares).
eligibility: All land-owning farmers and tenant farmers in Gujarat growing notified crops during Kharif season
application_mode: Online via E-Gram Centers / Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Kisan Suryodaya Yojana
description: Provides uninterrupted daytime electricity supply (5:00 AM to 9:00 PM) to farmers for agricultural irrigation.
benefits: Guaranteed daytime power supply for crop irrigation, eliminating the need for hazardous nighttime farming activities.
eligibility: Farmers holding valid agricultural electricity connections across covered villages in Gujarat
documents: Agricultural Electricity Connection Consumer Number / Bill
application_mode: Automatic coverage by DISCOMs (GUVNL / PGVCL / DGVCL / MGVCL / UGVCL)

scheme_name: Gujarat Micro Irrigation Scheme (GGRC - Per Drop More Crop)
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) through Gujarat Green Revolution Company (GGRC) to optimize water usage in arid and semi-arid zones.
benefits: 70% to 80% subsidy on total installation costs of drip or sprinkler irrigation systems.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in Gujarat with access to an assured irrigation source
application_mode: Online via GGRC Portal or through authorized system suppliers

scheme_name: Integrated Horticulture Development Scheme
description: Offers assistance for fruit orchards, tissue culture banana, dragon fruit (Kamalam), papaya plantations, shade net houses, and high-tech greenhouses.
benefits: Subsidy ranging from 50% to 75% on planting materials, tissue culture plants, and greenhouse infrastructure setup.
eligibility: Individual farmers, SHGs, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) cultivating horticultural crops in Gujarat
application_mode: Online via Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Natural Farming Scheme (Prakrutik Kheti Scheme)
description: Provides financial incentives to adopt zero-budget natural farming (ZBNF), maintenance of indigenous cows, and purchase of natural input preparation kits.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹900 per month (₹10,800 per year) per family for maintaining an indigenous (Desi) cow for natural manure preparation, plus ₹750 for natural input kits.
eligibility: Farmers in Gujarat practicing natural farming using indigenous cow-based inputs
documents: Indigenous Cow Tagging / Veterinary Health Certificate
application_mode: Online via Ikhedut Portal / Gram Panchayat Office

scheme_name: Assistance for Fencing Around Agricultural Fields (Solar / Wire Mesh)
description: Offers subsidy for erecting solar powered fencing or barbed wire fencing around farm perimeters to protect crops from wild animals like blue bulls (Nilgai) and wild boars.
benefits: Financial grant up to 50% of the cost (maximum ₹200 per meter or up to ₹1,50,000 per field) for perimeter fencing.
eligibility: Farmers or groups of farmers owning contiguous land plots in Gujarat
application_mode: Online via Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Cow-Based Dairy Infrastructure Scheme (Gau Poshak Yojana)
description: Supports livestock rearers in constructing modern cattle sheds, purchasing milking machines, and establishing mini dairy units.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for cattle shed construction, silage units, and automatic milking machines up to ₹1,50,000.
eligibility: Livestock rearers, milk producers, and dairy SHGs residing in Gujarat
documents: Dairy Cooperative Membership Proof / Cattle Ownership Record
application_mode: Offline / Online via District Animal Husbandry Office / Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Assistance for Construction of Farm Ponds (Khet Talavadi)
description: Subsidizes the digging and plastic lining of farm ponds to harvest rainwater for supplementary irrigation in rainfed regions.
benefits: Financial assistance of 50% to 70% of total excavation/lining cost (up to ₹75,000–₹1,00,000 per pond).
eligibility: Land-owning farmers in rain-fed or drought-prone districts of Gujarat
documents: Site Layout Map for proposed pond
application_mode: Online via Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Marine & Freshwater Fisheries Infrastructure Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides capital subsidy for purchasing outboard motors, safety equipment, fish drying units, insulated ice boxes, and aquaculture pond construction.
benefits: 40% to 60% financial subsidy on fishing gear, boat engines, insulated transport vehicles, and fish farming inputs.
eligibility: Traditional fishermen, aquaculture farmers, and fisher cooperatives registered in Gujarat
documents: Boat Registration Certificate (for marine fishers) / Land Record (for aquaculture)
application_mode: Offline / Online via Commissionerate of Fisheries / Ikhedut Portal

scheme_name: Mera Pani Meri Virasat Yojana
description: Incentivizes farmers to switch from water-intensive paddy (rice) cultivation to alternative crops like maize, pulses, cotton, sesame, or horticultural crops to conserve groundwater.
benefits: Financial incentive of ₹7,000 per acre provided directly into the farmer's bank account for replacing paddy with alternative crops.
eligibility: Farmers residing and cultivating land in designated dark zones / groundwater stressed blocks of Haryana
Must register land and crop diversification details on the Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) portal
documents: Meri Fasal Mera Byora (MFMB) Registration ID
application_mode: Online via Meri Fasal Mera Byora Portal (fasal.haryana.gov.in)

scheme_name: Bhavantar Bharpayee Yojana (BBY)
description: Protects horticulture producers from market price fluctuations by compensating the difference between the protected price set by the government and the actual wholesale market selling price.
benefits: Direct financial compensation for the deficit amount when wholesale market prices fall below the fixed base support price for 21 notified vegetable and fruit crops.
eligibility: Vegetable and fruit growers owning or leasing land in Haryana
Compulsory registration of crop area on the MFMB portal during the notified sowing period
application_mode: Online via Meri Fasal Mera Byora Portal

scheme_name: Agricultural Machinery Subsidy & Crop Residue Management (CRM) Scheme
description: Provides financial subsidy on in-situ and ex-situ crop residue management machinery (Super Seeder, Happy Seeder, Straw Baler, Mulcher) to prevent paddy stubble burning.
benefits: 50% individual subsidy on purchase of stubble management machinery and 80% subsidy for Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) established by Panchayats or Farmer Groups.
eligibility: Individual land-owning farmers, Panchayats, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and Custom Hiring Centers in Haryana
Registration on MFMB portal is mandatory
application_mode: Online via Agri Haryana Portal (agriharyana.gov.in)

scheme_name: Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) Incentive Scheme
description: Encourages rice growers to adopt the Direct Seeded Rice (DSR) technique instead of traditional puddled transplantation to save irrigation water and energy.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹4,000 per acre deposited into the farmer's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
eligibility: Paddy cultivators in Haryana who sow rice directly using DSR machines
Verification of DSR fields conducted by district agriculture officers
application_mode: Online via Meri Fasal Mera Byora Portal

scheme_name: Haryana Pashudhan Bima Yojana & Pashu Kisan Credit Card
description: Provides free or low-cost livestock insurance for cows, buffaloes, sheep, goats, and pigs, along with collateral-free short-term credit cards for animal rearers.
benefits: Free insurance coverage up to ₹80,000 per cattle for BPL families (nominal premium for general categories) and working capital credit line up to ₹1,60,000 without collateral.
eligibility: Livestock rearers residing in Haryana holding valid Parivar Pehchan Patra (PPP)
Animals must be ear-tagged with UID
documents: Ear Tag Number / Livestock Health Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Government Veterinary Hospitals or Banks

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Component-B (Solar Water Pumping Scheme)
description: Offers heavy subsidies to farmers for replacing diesel pumps or installing new off-grid solar powered water pumps (3 HP to 10 HP) for crop irrigation.
benefits: 75% total subsidy (45% state subsidy + 30% central subsidy), with the farmer bearing only 25% of the capital cost.
eligibility: Farmers having land records and existing micro-irrigation systems (drip/sprinkler) or opting for new micro-irrigation setup in Haryana
Preference given to farmers without existing grid electricity connections for farming
application_mode: Online via HAREDA / Saral Haryana Portal (saralharyana.gov.in)

scheme_name: Integrated Horticulture Development Plan (IHDP)
description: Subsidizes high-tech greenhouses, polyhouses, shade-net structures, pack houses, cold storage units, and fruit orchard plantations.
benefits: 50% to 65% capital subsidy for establishing polyhouses, shade nets, micro-irrigation in orchards, and post-harvest infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmers, FPOs, and agri-entrepreneurs in Haryana registered on the Horticulture Department portal
documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) / Technical Cost Estimate
application_mode: Online via Haryana Horticulture Portal (hortharyana.gov.in)

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Evam Khetihar Mazdoor Jeevan Suraksha Yojana
description: Provides financial compensation to farmers and agricultural laborers in case of accidental death or permanent disability while operating farm machinery.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹5,00,000 in case of death or total disability, and ₹37,500 to ₹2,50,000 for partial disability / loss of limbs during farm operations.
eligibility: All farmers and farm workers aged between 12 and 65 years residing in Haryana
documents: FIR Copy / Police Report of Accident
Post-Mortem Report / Disability Certificate from CMO
Aadhaar Card and Bank Account Details of Beneficiary/Nominee
application_mode: Offline / Online via Haryana State Agricultural Marketing Board (HSAMB) / Saral Portal

scheme_name: Promotion of Cotton Cultivation and Desi Cotton Scheme
description: Encourages cotton growers to cultivate indigenous (Desi) cotton varieties and adopt integrated pest management (IPM) practices against pink bollworm.
benefits: Direct cash assistance of ₹3,000 per acre for Desi cotton growers along with subsidized bio-pesticides and pheromone traps.
eligibility: Cotton farmers in major cotton-producing districts of Haryana (Sirsa, Fatehabad, Hisar, Jind, Bhiwani)
Registration on MFMB portal is required
application_mode: Online via Agri Haryana / MFMB Portal

scheme_name: Intensive Fisheries Development & Inland Aquaculture Scheme
description: Provides subsidy for excavating new fish ponds, re-circulatory aquaculture systems (RAS), biofloc units, fish feed, and solar power unit integration for aquaculture.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for SC/ST and Women farmers on total unit construction cost and operational inputs.
eligibility: Landowners, lessees, or panchayat land-lessees in Haryana taking up fish farming or shrimp culture in saline water areas
application_mode: Offline / Online via Haryana Fisheries Department Portal

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Utpadan Sanrakshan Yojana (Solar Fencing & Protection)
description: Integrated scheme offering subsidies for solar fencing, interlink chain fencing, anti-hail nets, and polyhouse greenhouse renovation to protect crops against monkeys, wild animals, and severe hail damage.
benefits: 80% subsidy for individual farmers and 85% subsidy for group farming (3 or more farmers) on solar power fencing; 80% assistance for anti-hail nets up to 5,000 sq m; 70% assistance for greenhouse polyhouse sheet replacement.
eligibility: Permanent resident farmers of Himachal Pradesh owning cultivable land
Priority provided to small, marginal, and hill-region farmers
application_mode: Online via HP DBT Portal (agridbt.hp.gov.in)

scheme_name: Prakritik Kheti Khushal Kisan Yojana (PKKKY)
description: Promotes chemical-free Zero Budget Natural Farming (ZBNF) by supporting indigenous (Desi) cow purchase, bio-input preparation kits, cattle shed lining, and farm-level input shops.
benefits: 50% subsidy up to ₹25,000 (plus ₹5,000 transport allowance) for purchasing indigenous cows; ₹8,000 for cattle shed lining; ₹2,250 for plastic drums; and one-time assistance of ₹50,000 over 3 years for setting up natural input shops.
eligibility: Farmers residing in Himachal Pradesh committed to adopting non-chemical natural farming practices
documents: Desi Cow Ownership / Purchase Bill (for cow subsidy)
application_mode: Online / Offline via State Natural Farming Portal (spnfhp.in) or ATMA Block Offices

scheme_name: Him Unnati Yojana
description: Supports cluster-based development in agriculture and allied sectors by linking farm production with processing, storage, branding, and direct market linkage.
benefits: Financial grants and technical assistance up to 80% for forming farmer clusters, establishing common facility centers, and value addition infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmer Self-Help Groups (SHGs), Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and smallholder clusters in Himachal Pradesh
documents: List of Member Farmers with Land Records
Aadhaar Cards of Key Office Bearers
application_mode: Online via HP Agriculture Portal / District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Jal Se Krishi Ko Bal Yojana
description: Focuses on constructing small check dams, farm ponds, and community lift irrigation or flow irrigation schemes to harness water sources in hilly terrains.
benefits: 100% state funding for community check dam construction and up to 80% financial assistance for individual lift irrigation pumpsets and piping.
eligibility: Individual farmers or community groups of farmers in rainfed agricultural regions of Himachal Pradesh
documents: NOC from Gram Panchayat / Irrigation Source Access Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Block Development / Agriculture Officer or Online via eDistrict HP

scheme_name: Krishi Se Sampannta Yojana (Hing and Saffron Cultivation)
description: Promotes commercial cultivation of high-value cash crops like Asafoetida (Hing) and Saffron in suitable high-altitude regions (Chamba, Lahaul-Spiti, Kinnaur, Kullu).
benefits: Free supply of high-quality planting material (corms/seeds), 75% subsidy on specialized soil inputs, and free technical guidance from CSIR-IHBT Palampur.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in notified high-altitude agro-climatic zones of Himachal Pradesh
application_mode: Offline application through District Agriculture Extension Offices

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Green House Renovation & Polyhouse Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides capital subsidies for constructing new polyhouses and replacing worn-out poly-sheets/UV films after 5 years or following natural calamity damage.
benefits: 85% subsidy for establishing polyhouse/greenhouse structures and 70% assistance for poly-sheet replacement.
eligibility: Horticulture and vegetable growers residing in Himachal Pradesh with eligible land titles
documents: Polyhouse Site Map and Cost Estimate
application_mode: Online via HP DBT Portal (agridbt.hp.gov.in)

scheme_name: Him Kukkut Palan Yojana (Poultry Development)
description: Encourages rural women and small farmers to set up backyard poultry units and commercial broilers/layers to boost subsidiary income.
benefits: 60% to 75% subsidy on purchasing day-old chicks, poultry feed, and night-shelter cage construction for 100 to 500 bird units.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Himachal Pradesh; priority given to BPL families, Women SHGs, and SC/ST farmers
application_mode: Online via eDistrict Himachal / Offline at Veterinary Hospitals

scheme_name: Doodh Protsahan Yojana
description: Offers direct price incentive bonuses per liter to dairy farmers selling cow and buffalo milk through organized cooperative societies.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer (DBT) price support subsidy directly into farmers' bank accounts based on milk fat content and quantity logged by cooperatives.
eligibility: Milk producers registered with primary dairy cooperative societies in Himachal Pradesh
application_mode: Offline registration through local Dairy Cooperative Society / HP MILKFED

scheme_name: Anti-Hail Net Scheme for Apple & Fruit Orchards
description: Subsidizes high-density anti-hail nets to safeguard high-value apple, plum, peach, and cherry orchards from summer hailstorms.
benefits: 80% subsidy on the purchase of government-approved anti-hail nets up to a maximum area of 5,000 square meters per beneficiary.
eligibility: Orchard owners and fruit growers with registered land in Himachal Pradesh
documents: Jamabandi Land Extract showing orchard status
application_mode: Online via HP Horticulture DBT Portal

scheme_name: Inland Fisheries & Trout Farming Promotion Scheme
description: Promotes cold-water trout farming and carp culture by providing capital subsidies for raceway construction, trout hatcheries, fish feed, and solar aerators.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% for SC/ST and Women beneficiaries on trout unit construction cost (up to ₹3,30,000 per unit).
eligibility: Fish farmers and unemployed youth residing in cold-water stream regions of Himachal Pradesh with land and water flow availability
documents: Land Ownership Document or 10-year Lease Deed
Water Availability / NOC Certificate from Jal Shakti Department
application_mode: Offline / Online via HP Fisheries Department Portal

scheme_name: Holistic Agriculture Development Programme (HADP)
description: An umbrella initiative encompassing 29 sector-specific projects designed to modernize farming, improve crop yields, boost seed production, and promote high-value organic and niche crops across J&K.
benefits: 50% to 80% capital subsidies, free high-quality seeds, machinery support, and credit linkage across agriculture, horticulture, livestock, and apiculture sectors.
eligibility: Farmers, farm youth, agri-entrepreneurs, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) residing in Jammu & Kashmir
Registration on the Kisan Khidmat Portal is mandatory
application_mode: Online via Kisan Khidmat Portal (hadp.jk.gov.in)

scheme_name: High Density Apple Plantation Scheme
description: Encourages apple growers to transition from traditional apple orchards to High-Density Apple Plantations (HDAP) using rootstocks for higher density and early commercial yields.
benefits: 50% subsidy on setting up high-density orchards, including imported dwarf/semi-dwarf rootstocks, anti-hail net structures, drip irrigation, and trellising systems.
eligibility: Individual orchardists, land-owning farmers, or registered grower groups in J&K
Minimum land area holding of 1 Kanal (0.125 acre) dedicated to high-density setup
application_mode: Online via HADP / J&K Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: JK Saffron Mission & Rejuvenation Scheme
description: Aims to boost the productivity of world-renowned Kashmiri Saffron by supporting corm multiplication, drip irrigation setup, and access to India International Saffron Trade Centre (IISTC) for grading and processing.
benefits: Subsidized high-quality saffron corms, 100% assistance for solar irrigation connections, and free quality testing/e-auction access at IISTC Dussu, Pulwama.
eligibility: Traditional saffron growers and new farmers in notified saffron belts (Pulwama, Budgam, Srinagar, and Kishtwar districts)
documents: Land Revenue Certificate confirming Saffron Land status
application_mode: Online via HADP Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri / LG Green Cold Chain & Post-Harvest Scheme
description: Provides financial support to build Controlled Atmosphere (CA) cold stores, refrigerated vans, and pack houses to prevent post-harvest losses of perishable fruits like apples, cherries, and walnuts.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2 Crore per project) for constructing CA stores, solar-powered pack-houses, and cold chain transport.
eligibility: Agri-entrepreneurs, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), Cooperatives, and individual orchardists in J&K
application_mode: Online via J&K HADP / Horticulture Department Portal

scheme_name: J&K Integrated Sheep & Goat Development Scheme (ISGDS)
description: Encourages establishment of sheep and goat breeding units to meet local mutton demand, boost Pashmina/wool production, and generate rural employment.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy up to ₹1,25,000 for setting up 25-ewe/doe units, plus free veterinary care, tagging, and insurance coverage.
eligibility: Unemployed youth, small and marginal farmers, and nomadic migratory tribals (Gujjars/Bakarwals) residing in J&K
application_mode: Online via Kisan Khidmat / Offline via District Sheep Husbandry Officer

scheme_name: Promotion of Medicinal & Aromatic Plants (MAPs)
description: Promotes commercial cultivation of high-value medicinal and aromatic plants such as Lavender, Rose, Muskmelon, and Rosemary under the Lavender / Purple Revolution banner.
benefits: Free supply of quality planting material (QPM/cuttings), 50% subsidy on distillation units, and direct market buyback linkages through CSIR-IIIM.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable hilly or rainfed land across all districts of J&K, especially Doda, Ramban, Kishtwar, and Kashmir valley
application_mode: Online via HADP Portal / CSIR-IIIM Jammu

scheme_name: Sericulture Development & Mulberry Plantation Scheme
description: Supports silk farmers by providing high-yielding mulberry saplings, rearing appliances, and financial grants for constructing modern silkworm rearing houses.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹1,25,000 for constructing rearing houses, free mulberry saplings, and subsidized silkworm seed (chawki) supplies.
eligibility: Traditional silk rearers, women SHGs, and smallholders in J&K having space for mulberry cultivation
documents: Land Record Extract for Mulberry Plantation
application_mode: Offline via Sericulture Development Department Offices or Online via HADP Portal

scheme_name: Integrated Apiculture Development Scheme (IADS)
description: Promotes scientific beekeeping for honey and beeswax production, boosting overall crop pollination and generating supplementary farm income.
benefits: 80% subsidy for SC/ST/Women beneficiaries and 50% for General category on purchase of bee hives, colonies, honey extractors, and migration transportation.
eligibility: Farmers, rural youth, and SHG groups residing in Jammu & Kashmir
application_mode: Online via HADP / Kisan Khidmat Portal

scheme_name: Trout Culture & Commercial Aquaculture Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes commercial cold-water trout farming in running water raceways across high-altitude streams and carp culture in plain areas.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for SC/ST/Women on constructing running-water trout raceways (up to ₹5,50,000 per unit cost base), fish seed, and floating feed.
eligibility: Unemployed youth, small farmers, and cooperative groups in J&K with suitable land and perennial cold water supply
documents: NOC / Water Feasibility Certificate from Jal Shakti Department
application_mode: Online via Kisan Khidmat / Offline via District Fisheries Officer

scheme_name: J&K Solar Pump / Micro-Irrigation Promotion Scheme
description: Encourages farmers in off-grid or rainfed areas to install solar-powered irrigation pumpsets integrated with drip and sprinkler irrigation units.
benefits: Up to 80% combined central and UT subsidy on solar water pump setups (up to 10 HP) and 80% subsidy on drip/sprinkler micro-irrigation kits.
eligibility: Farmers holding agricultural land in J&K without regular electricity supply for irrigation
application_mode: Online via JAKEDA / HADP Portal

scheme_name: Birsa Fasal Rahat Yojana (Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana)
description: A financial compensation scheme replacing crop insurance, providing direct monetary assistance to farmers who face major crop losses due to drought, floods, or unseasonal weather.
benefits: Financial relief of ₹3,000 per acre for crop damage between 30% and 50%; ₹4,000 per acre for crop damage exceeding 50% (up to a maximum cap of 5 acres per farmer).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and tenant/sharecropper farmers residing in Jharkhand
Must have cultivated crops during the notified Kharif or Rabi season on registered land
documents: Land Possession Certificate (LPC) or Revenue Receipt
Self-Declaration Form for Sharecroppers/Tenant Farmers (certified by Mukhiya/Patwari)
application_mode: Online via JRFRY Portal (jrfry.jharkhand.gov.in) or CSC Outlets

scheme_name: Birsa Harit Gram Yojana
description: Promotes fruit orchard cultivation (mango, guava, lemon, teak) on fallow or unutilized land under MGNREGA, generating long-term sustainable income for rural households.
benefits: Free supply of high-yielding fruit saplings (100 plants per acre), 100% wage coverage for land preparation/fencing/pitting under MGNREGA, and complete maintenance support for 3 years.
eligibility: Rural households with MGNREGA Job Card owning 0.5 to 1 acre of fallow/barren land
Priority given to SC/ST households, single women, and smallholder farmers
documents: Bank Account Details linked to MGNREGA
application_mode: Offline through Gram Sabha / MGNREGA Block Program Officer (BPO)

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Yantrikaran Yojana
description: Provides financial subsidies to small and marginal farmers, SHGs, and FPOs to purchase modern agricultural machinery like tractors, rotavators, power tillers, and harvesters.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on farm implements and micro-tractors for individual farmers; up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) by Women SHGs.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Jharkhand, Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and registered FPOs
application_mode: Online via Jharkhand Krishi Portal / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Birsa Munda Irrigation / Well Construction Scheme
description: Provides financial support for digging open irrigation wells (Kua Construction) to ensure round-the-year water availability for small-scale farming and vegetable growing.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹5,00,000 per well constructed under MGNREGA and state agriculture convergence funds.
eligibility: Small and marginal SC/ST farmers owning arable land with suitable underground water table
application_mode: Offline via Gram Panchayat / Block Development Office (BDO)

scheme_name: Jharkhand Organic Farming Promotion Scheme
description: Encourages adoption of chemical-free organic farming practices through cluster formation, training, bio-input distribution, and free Third-Party PGS Organic Certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, vermicompost unit construction, and free group organic certification.
