eligibility: Farmers or farmer groups/clusters (minimum 20 hectares total) committed to organic practices in Jharkhand
application_mode: Online via Jharkhand State Organic Certification Agency (JSOCA) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Siddho-Kanho Agriculture and Forestry Co-operative Development Scheme
description: Strengthens rural cooperatives involved in collecting, processing, and marketing minor forest produce (Tendu leaves, Mahua, Lac, Sal seeds) and rainfed crops.
benefits: Financial assistance, working capital soft loans, and processing equipment subsidies up to 75% for tribal co-operatives and SHGs.
eligibility: Primary Agriculture Cooperative Societies (PACS), Forest Cooperatives, and Tribal SHGs in Jharkhand
documents: List of Member Farmers / Forest Collectors
Bank Account Details of the Society
application_mode: Offline through District Cooperative Officer (DCO) / Cooperative Department Portal

scheme_name: Jharkhand Dairy Development Scheme (Kamdhenu Scheme)
description: Promotes high-yielding crossbred cow and buffalo rearing, establishment of mini dairy units (2 to 10 cattle), and setting up automatic milk collection centers.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for General category and up to 75% subsidy for SC/ST and Women beneficiaries on purchase of milch cattle and construction of cattle sheds.
eligibility: Permanent resident livestock farmers, women SHGs, and rural unemployed youth in Jharkhand
documents: Land Availability Proof for Cattle Shed
application_mode: Offline via District Animal Husbandry Officer (DAHO) or Online via State AH Portal

scheme_name: Integrated Lac Cultivation Promotion Scheme
description: Supports traditional lac growers by providing high-yielding brood lac, pruning equipment, host tree (Ber, Palas, Kusum) care, and processing support.
benefits: Free supply of brood lac seeds, 80% subsidy on lac processing kits, and free technical training provided by ICAR-IINRG Ranchi.
eligibility: Tribal and smallholder lac farmers residing in notified forest/fringe districts of Jharkhand
documents: Forest Right / Land Document for Host Trees
application_mode: Offline via District Forest Office / ICAR-IINRG / Block Extension Office

scheme_name: Mukhya Mantri Fisheries Development Scheme (Cage Culture & Ponds)
description: Promotes fish production through cage culture in large reservoirs (e.g., Chandil Dam), renovation of old ponds, and setting up fish hatcheries.
benefits: 50% to 60% subsidy for setting up fish farming cages, purchasing fish seed/feed, and constructing new fish ponds (up to ₹2.5 Lakh per acre).
eligibility: Local fishermen, displaced reservoir families, SHGs, and small farmers in Jharkhand
documents: Fishermen Cooperative Membership Proof / Land LPC
Displaced Family Certificate (for reservoir cage culture)
application_mode: Online via Jharkhand Fisheries Portal / District Fisheries Office

scheme_name: Solar Pump Installation Scheme (PM-KUSUM Component-B Jharkhand)
description: Helps farmers replace diesel pumps with stand-alone solar water pumps for reliable, cost-effective irrigation in un-electrified agricultural fields.
benefits: Up to 80% combined state and central subsidy on standalone solar pumpsets (3 HP to 7.5 HP capacity).
eligibility: Individual farmers, water user associations, and joint liability groups owning land in Jharkhand without electricity access
documents: Declaration of No Existing Electric Connection on Pump Site
application_mode: Online via JREDA Portal (jreda.com) or District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Raitha Siri Scheme
description: Incentivizes farmers to grow nutrient-dense millets (like Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, and Foxtail Millet) to promote sustainable dryland agriculture and dietary health.
benefits: Direct financial aid of ₹10,000 per hectare transferred directly into the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating eligible millet crops in Karnataka
Landholding registered on the FruitKantara / FRUITS Portal
documents: Pahani / RTC (Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops)
FRUITS ID (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System)
application_mode: Online via Karnataka FRUITS Portal

scheme_name: Krishi Bhagya Scheme
description: A flagship scheme designed for dryland farmers in rainfed regions to ensure water security through farm ponds (Krishi Hondas), polythene lining, diesel/solar pumpsets, and micro-irrigation systems.
benefits: Subsidies up to 80% to 90% for constructing farm ponds, installing tarpaulin linings, and setting up drip/sprinkler units.
eligibility: Dryland farmers in rainfed agricultural zones of Karnataka owning cultivable land
application_mode: Online via Raitha Mitra / FRUITS Portal

scheme_name: Karnataka Crop Loan Waiver Scheme / Zero-Interest Loan
description: Provides interest-free short-term crop loans through primary agricultural cooperative societies (PACS) and cooperative banks to meet seasonal crop production costs.
benefits: 0% interest on short-term crop loans up to ₹5 Lakh, and 3% interest on medium/long-term loans up to ₹15 Lakh upon timely repayment.
eligibility: Resident farmers of Karnataka with valid land records (RTC)
Active members of Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACS)
application_mode: Online via PACS / District Central Cooperative Banks (DCCBs)

scheme_name: Surya Raitha Scheme
description: Empowers farmers to replace traditional irrigation pumpsets with grid-connected solar pumpsets, allowing them to irrigate crops during the day and sell surplus solar power back to the grid.
benefits: Up to 90% subsidy on solar pumpset setup; steady supplementary income generated by selling excess power to ESCOMs.
eligibility: Farmers owning land with a valid borewell/irrigation source in Karnataka
application_mode: Online via Karnataka Renewable Energy Development Ltd (KREDL) / ESCOM Portals

scheme_name: Yashasvini Health Insurance Scheme for Farmers
description: A cashless health insurance program specifically structured for members of rural cooperative societies and their farming families, covering major surgeries and medical treatments.
benefits: Cashless surgical and medical treatment coverage up to ₹5 Lakh per family per year at empaneled network hospitals.
eligibility: Members of rural cooperative societies in Karnataka for at least 3 months
Farmer family members residing in rural areas
documents: Yashasvini Member Card / Cooperative Society Passbook
application_mode: Cooperative Societies / Online Portal

scheme_name: Krishi Yanthrikadhare Scheme
description: Establishes Custom Hiring Service Centers (CHSCs) across hoblis/taluks to provide small and marginal farmers easy access to expensive farm machinery on a rental basis.
benefits: Rental access to tractors, harvesters, power tillers, and transplanting machines at 30% to 50% below standard market rental rates.
eligibility: All farmers in Karnataka, with priority given to small and marginal landholders
application_mode: Online Booking via Krishi Yanthrikadhare App / Local Hobli Center

scheme_name: Ksheera Samruddhi Sahakara Bank / Ksheera Bhagya
description: Supports dairy farmers across Karnataka by offering financial incentives on milk production supplied to cooperative milk unions (KMF / Nandini).
benefits: Direct financial cash subsidy of ₹5 per liter of milk supplied to local milk producers' cooperative societies.
eligibility: Dairy farmers registered as active members of Karnataka Milk Federation (KMF) affiliated societies
application_mode: Milk Producers Cooperative Society (MPCS) local branch

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME) - Karnataka
description: Provides credit-linked capital subsidies for establishing or upgrading micro food processing enterprises like flour mills, spice processing, fruit pulping, and oil extraction units.
benefits: 35% credit-linked capital subsidy (up to ₹10 Lakh) per unit for individual micro-enterprises.
eligibility: Individual micro-entrepreneurs, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), SHGs, and cooperatives in Karnataka
application_mode: Online via PMFME Portal / Karnataka State Agricultural Produce Processing Corporation (KAPPEC)

scheme_name: Organic Farming & Soil Health Card Scheme - Karnataka
description: Provides comprehensive soil testing and customized nutrient management advisory, alongside subsidies for bio-fertilizers, vermicomposting units, and organic farm inputs.
benefits: Free Soil Health Cards with crop-specific fertilizer recommendations and up to 50% subsidy on organic inputs.
eligibility: All farmers holding agricultural land in Karnataka
application_mode: Online / Local Raitha Samparka Kendra (RSK)

scheme_name: Pashu Bhagya Scheme
description: Provides subsidized bank loans to small/marginal farmers and landless agricultural laborers for purchasing cattle, sheep, goats, pigs, and poultry to support rural livelihoods.
benefits: 33.33% subsidy for SC/ST beneficiaries and 25% subsidy for general category beneficiaries on animal husbandry loans up to ₹1.2 Lakh.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, landless agricultural laborers residing in Karnataka
documents: RTC Copy or Landless Laborer Certificate
application_mode: Online / Department of Animal Husbandry and Veterinary Services (AHVS)

scheme_name: Subhiksha Keralam - Integrated Agricultural Development
description: A comprehensive food self-sufficiency program bringing fallow lands back into active cultivation for paddy, vegetables, tubers, and pulses.
benefits: Incentive grants up to ₹40,000/hectare for fallow land cultivation, subsidized seeds, organic fertilizers, and credit facilities.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Kudumbashree groups, joint liability groups, and cooperatives in Kerala
application_mode: Online via AIMS Kerala Portal / Krishi Bhavan

scheme_name: Kerala State Crop Insurance Scheme (State Crop Insurance Policy)
description: Provides quick compensation for damages caused to key horticultural, cash, and food crops due to natural hazards including flood, landslide, and drought.
benefits: Fixed sum insured compensation (e.g., ₹300 per coconut palm, ₹100 per banana plant, ₹32,000/hectare for paddy) at nominal annual premiums.
eligibility: Farmers in Kerala cultivating 27 notified crops (paddy, banana, coconut, rubber, tapioca, spices, etc.)
application_mode: Online via AIMS Portal / Local Krishi Bhavan

scheme_name: Keragrama Scheme (Integrated Coconut Development)
description: A focused initiative to rejuvenate coconut farming through disease management, high-yielding sapling distribution, and micro-irrigation installation.
benefits: 50% subsidy for pump set installation, drip systems, cutting old trees, plant protection materials, and inter-cropping financial assistance.
eligibility: Coconut growers in Kerala owning at least 10 bearing coconut palms within designated Keragramam clusters
application_mode: Online via AIMS Portal / Krishi Bhavan Officer

scheme_name: Paddy Production Incentive (PPI)
description: Encourages paddy farmers by providing direct royalty/incentive per hectare to sustain wetland ecology and boost rice production.
benefits: Royalty payment of ₹3,000 per hectare per year directly transferred to the registered farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmers actively cultivating paddy in wetlands/fields across Kerala
application_mode: Online via AIMS Portal

scheme_name: Kerala Farm Mechanization & Custom Hiring Scheme
description: Promotes modern labor-saving machinery including paddy transplanters, mini-tractors, and brush cutters to overcome agricultural labor shortages.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on purchase of individual farm tools and support for setting up Karshika Karma Senas (CHC units).
eligibility: Individual smallholders, Karshika Karma Senas, and Kudumbashree JLGs in Kerala
application_mode: Online via AIMS Portal / Krishi Bhavan

scheme_name: Kera Suraksha Insurance Scheme for Coconut Tree Climbers
description: Comprehensive insurance coverage for coconut harvesters (Neera technicians / Friends of Coconut) against accidental injury or death during work.
benefits: Insurance cover up to ₹5,00,000 in case of death or permanent disability while harvesting or pruning.
eligibility: Trained coconut tree climbers and harvesters aged 18 to 65 years residing in Kerala
application_mode: Offline via Coconut Development Board / Krishi Bhavan

scheme_name: Kerala Organic & Natural Farming Mission (Jaiva Keralam)
description: Supports the conversion of conventional cropland into certified organic farming units and promotes bio-pesticide production units.
benefits: Financial support up to ₹20,000/hectare for organic conversion, free organic certification, and input distribution.
eligibility: Farmers and farmer clusters in Kerala practicing organic farming methods
application_mode: Online via AIMS Portal

scheme_name: Commercial Vegetable Production Development Scheme
description: Promotes high-value and off-season vegetable cultivation under rain-shelters and open fields to achieve vegetable self-reliance.
benefits: Subsidies up to ₹50,000 per unit for rain-shelter construction, hybrid seed distribution, and micro-irrigation kits.
eligibility: Individual vegetable growers and Kudumbashree groups in Kerala
application_mode: Online via AIMS Portal / Krishi Bhavan

scheme_name: Dairy Development Scheme (Milma Input Support)
description: Offers subsidized cattle feed, insurance support, and milking machine grants to dairy farmers to increase milk production.
benefits: 50% subsidy on cattle feed purchase, up to 75% grant for milking machine installation, and subsidized veterinary services.
eligibility: Dairy farmers supplying milk to registered Primary Milk Cooperative Societies (APCOS / Milma) in Kerala
application_mode: Offline via Primary Milk Cooperative Society / Dairy Extension Officer

scheme_name: Kerala Integrated Inland Fisheries Development Project
description: Encourages biofloc fish farming, cage culture, and shrimp farming in backwaters and freshwater ponds across coastal and inland districts.
benefits: 40% to 60% financial subsidy on cage setup, fingerling procurement, feed cost, and biofloc tanks.
eligibility: Inland fishers, youth entrepreneurs, and SHGs in Kerala registered with the Department of Fisheries
application_mode: Online via Matsyaaketham Portal / District Fisheries Office

scheme_name: Special Development Package - Poly Trench Green House Scheme
description: Provides financial and material assistance for setting up Poly Trench Greenhouses to enable winter vegetable cultivation in sub-zero Himalayan weather conditions.
benefits: Subsidized construction cost and Poly Film distribution for 30ft x 10ft x 5ft trench structures.
eligibility: Individual farmers and women farmer groups residing in Leh and Kargil districts of Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via Chief Agriculture Officer (CAO) Leh / Kargil

scheme_name: Ladakh Apricot & High-Density Apple Nursery Production Scheme
description: Encourages establishment of high-density fruit orchards (Raktsey Karpo Apricot and Apple) by funding nursery production and planting material.
benefits: Direct cash assistance and subsidized planting material for high-density orchard creation.
eligibility: Farmers and orchardists in Leh and Kargil possessing agricultural land
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office, Leh/Kargil

scheme_name: Subsidized Power Tiller & Weeder Distribution Scheme
description: Distributes light-weight, high-altitude suitable farm machinery like power tillers and weeders to reduce farm labor bottlenecks.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹60,000 max per unit) on Power Tillers and Weeders.
eligibility: Individual small and marginal farmers residing in UT Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via Block Agriculture Extension Officer

scheme_name: Buckwheat & Black Zeera Production Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes the cultivation of high-value native crops like Buckwheat and Black Zeera (Cumin) suited to cold desert ecology.
benefits: Incentive of ₹3,000 per Kanal for Buckwheat and ₹6,000 per Kanal for Black Zeera cultivation.
eligibility: Farmers growing native Buckwheat or Black Cumin in Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Ladakh Organic Farming Promotion & Vermicompost Scheme
description: Supports conversion to 100% organic farming by subsidizing the setup of Vermicompost units and bio-fertilizer supply.
benefits: Financial aid for building 30x8x2.5 ft vermicompost pits plus free bio-inputs.
eligibility: Individual farmers and organic cluster farming groups in UT Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via Agriculture/Horticulture Department, UT Ladakh

scheme_name: Freight Subsidy for Air Cargo/Road Transport of Fruits
description: Provides air freight and transport subsidies to fruit growers to transport perishable fruits like fresh apricots and cherry outside Ladakh.
benefits: 75% transport subsidy on air freight/road freight charges for sending local fruit produce to mainland markets.
eligibility: Registered fruit growers, cooperatives, and agri-entrepreneurs in Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via Chief Horticulture Officer

scheme_name: Solarized Light Trap & Pest Management Support
description: Distributes solar light traps and pheromone trap toolkits for chemical-free insect control in fruit orchards.
benefits: 75% subsidy on solar light traps, pheromone traps, and canopy management toolkits.
eligibility: Fruit and vegetable growers in Leh and Kargil
application_mode: Offline via Horticulture Inspector / Agriculture Extension Officer

scheme_name: Borewell & Water Harvesting System Scheme
description: Offers direct financial assistance to dig borewells and build water storage tanks for irrigation in arid cold-desert areas.
benefits: Cash grant assistance for borewell digging, water lift pumps, and micro-storage tanks.
eligibility: Farmers without assured surface water sources in UT Ladakh
documents: NOC from Local Panchayat / Revenue Dept
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Drip & Micro-Irrigation Subsidy Scheme
description: Improves water efficiency in dry valley orchards through drip irrigation systems.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy @ up to ₹73,000 per hectare for micro-drip layout.
eligibility: Orchardists and crop cultivators in Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Tubular UV-Film Structure Assistance for SHGs
description: Provides high-grade UV-resistant greenhouse structures to women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) for commercial seedling and vegetable raising.
benefits: 100% subsidy (up to ₹25,500 per unit) for community/SHG level tubular UV structures.
eligibility: Registered Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in Ladakh
application_mode: Offline via Block Development / Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Lakshadweep Organic Coconut Farming & Development Scheme
description: Supports local islanders in maintaining 100% organic status for coconut cultivation through certified high-yielding dwarf/hybrid seedlings, bio-inputs, micro-irrigation, and solar copra processing equipment.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on dwarf/hybrid coconut seedlings, organic input kits, copra dryers, and virgin coconut oil (VCO) processing units.
eligibility: Native landholders and registered coconut growers in Lakshadweep UT.
Must commit to 100% organic agricultural practices with zero chemical inputs.
documents: Land Ownership Record (Pattayam / Island Land Record)
application_mode: Offline via Department of Agriculture, UT Administration Lakshadweep

scheme_name: PM Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY - Lakshadweep Chapter)
description: Customized central scheme for island fisherfolk to modernize deep-sea tuna fishing, establish seaweed culture, install modern fish processing/drying infrastructure, and improve safety at sea.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for Women/ST beneficiaries for motorized/deep-sea fishing boats, safety gear, solar fish dryers, and seaweed farming rafts.
eligibility: Resident fishermen, fish farmers, traditional tuna fishers, and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in Lakshadweep.
Valid Fishermen Identity Card issued by Lakshadweep Fisheries Department.
application_mode: Offline/Online via Department of Fisheries, Kavaratti / Respective Island Administration

scheme_name: Lakshadweep Coconut Climbers & Tappers Welfare Scheme
description: Provides occupational safety equipment, free personal insurance coverage, and harvesting incentives to traditional coconut climbers and Neera tappers across all inhabited islands.
benefits: Free hydraulic/mechanical palm climbing safety gear, ₹5 Lakh comprehensive personal accident insurance cover, and financial assistance per palm harvested/tapped.
eligibility: Native residents engaged in coconut palm harvesting or Neera tapping in Lakshadweep UT.
Registered with the local Dweep Panchayat Agriculture Wing.
application_mode: Offline through Dweep Panchayats / Island Agricultural Extension Officers

scheme_name: Lakshadweep Fishermen Cooperative Loan & Boat Subsidy Scheme
description: Offers low-interest revolving credit and equipment subsidies through primary fishermen cooperative societies for acquiring navigational equipment, nets, and outboard motors.
benefits: Low-interest loans up to ₹2 Lakh at 4% interest per annum along with up to 50% capital subsidy on OBM (Outboard Motors) and navigational GPS/Sonar units.
eligibility: Active members of registered Fishermen Cooperative Societies in Lakshadweep.
Resident of any of the 10 inhabited islands.
application_mode: Offline via Island Primary Fishermen Cooperative Societies

scheme_name: Lakshadweep Island Development Higher Education Scholarship
description: Financial aid for native students of Lakshadweep who travel to mainland India (Kerala, Tamil Nadu, etc.) to pursue undergraduate, professional, and postgraduate higher education.
benefits: Annual scholarship stipend up to ₹18,000 to ₹25,000 per year covering mainland travel, hostel accommodation, and education expenses.
eligibility: Native Scheduled Tribe (ST) students domiciled in Lakshadweep UT.
Enrolled in recognized higher education courses in mainland institutions.
application_mode: Online via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) / UT Education Directorate

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) for Marine Fishery & Agriculture - Lakshadweep
description: Extends short-term working capital credit to traditional island farmers, coconut growers, and marine fishermen at subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Revolving credit limit up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (after 3% prompt repayment incentive).
eligibility: Island farmers, coconut landholders, and marine fishermen operating in UT Lakshadweep.
No default history in local cooperative or commercial banks.
documents: Land Record / Fishing Boat Registration Certificate
application_mode: Offline through Syndicate Bank / Canara Bank / SBI branches in Lakshadweep

scheme_name: Lakshadweep Eco-Tourism & Island Homestay Incentive Scheme
description: Encourages native island youth and local households to establish regulated, sustainable eco-homestays and water sports ventures to boost local tourism revenue.
benefits: Capital financial grant up to ₹2 Lakh for homestay interior renovation, eco-toilet setup, and certified water sports operator training.
eligibility: Native Lakshadweep residents owning residential property suitable for homestays.
Must adhere to Lakshadweep Eco-Tourism guidelines and environmental clearance norms.
documents: Homestay Registration Form with UT Tourism Dept
application_mode: Offline via Society for Promotion of Nature Tourism & Sports (SPORTS) / Tourism Dept

scheme_name: PM Vishwakarma Scheme (Lakshadweep Artisans Chapter)
description: Provides end-to-end support to traditional boat builders, coir artisans, net weavers, and wood carvers native to Lakshadweep.
benefits: ₹15,000 toolkit grant, free skill training with ₹500/day stipend, and collateral-free loan up to ₹3 Lakh at 5% interest rate.
eligibility: Native artisans practicing one of 18 eligible trades (e.g., boat makers, coir craftspersons).
Minimum age 18 years; restricted to one person per household.
application_mode: Online via PM Vishwakarma Portal / CSCs on islands

scheme_name: Lakshadweep Social Security Pension Scheme
description: UT-administered welfare pension scheme providing direct financial assistance to senior citizens, widows, and persons with benchmark disabilities residing across the islands.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) of ₹1,500 per month directly into beneficiary bank accounts.
eligibility: Permanent resident senior citizens (aged 60+), widows, or disabled individuals (40%+ disability).
Must belong to Low Income / BPL households on the island.
documents: Age Proof / Disability Certificate / Widow Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Social Welfare & Tribal Affairs, Kavaratti

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Lakshadweep Island Edition)
description: Provides specialized, light-weight agricultural machinery suitable for sandy coral soil and island conditions, including coir defibering machines, shredders, and mini-cultivators.
benefits: 50% to 60% capital financial subsidy on approved light farm and coir-processing machinery.
eligibility: Small and marginal island farmers, women SHGs, and agricultural coir worker groups.
application_mode: Online via Farmech Agri Machinery Portal / Island Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Kalyan Yojana
description: A state top-up financial assistance initiative supplementing PM-KISAN payouts to ensure predictable cash flow for agricultural input purchases.
benefits: An additional annual cash transfer of ₹6,000 paid directly to the farmer's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) in equal installments.
eligibility: Resident landholding farmers of Madhya Pradesh
Must be active and verified beneficiaries of the central PM-KISAN scheme
application_mode: Online via MP e-Uparjan / SAARA Portal

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Bhavantar Bhugtan Yojana
description: Protects farmers against market price crashes by paying the direct price difference whenever notified oilseeds and pulses sell below the Minimum Support Price (MSP) in state mandis.
benefits: Direct payment of the price gap between the MSP and market/model price directly into the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmers in MP cultivating notified Kharif/Rabi crops (soybean, pulses, oilseeds)
Must register produce on the e-Uparjan portal and sell through notified Krishi Upaj Mandis
documents: Mandi Sale Receipt & Weighment Slip (Toul Parchi)
application_mode: Online via MP e-Uparjan Portal / Mandi Samiti Office

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Solar Pump Yojana (MP)
description: Subsidizes standalone solar photovoltaic water pumping systems for agricultural irrigation in remote and off-grid farmlands.
benefits: Up to 90% capital subsidy on solar pumpsets (3 HP to 10 HP); farmers pay the remaining 10% share.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in MP with a verified water source (well, borewell, or stream)
Must not have an active grid-connected agricultural electricity connection
application_mode: Online via MP Solar Pump Portal

scheme_name: MP Krishi Yantra Anudan Yojana
description: Provides financial grants to smallholders and farmer groups to purchase tractors, combine harvesters, rotavators, seed drills, and power tillers.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy (up to ₹1,50,000 – ₹2,00,000 depending on machine type and farmer category).
eligibility: Landholding farmers registered on the DBT Agriculture Portal of MP
Higher subsidy priority for SC/ST, women, and small/marginal farmers
application_mode: Online via MP DBT Farmer Portal (e-Krishi Yantra)

scheme_name: MP Micro-Irrigation Scheme (Drip & Sprinkler)
description: Promotes efficient water use by subsidizing drip and sprinkler systems across drought-prone and water-stressed districts.
benefits: 70% to 80% subsidy for small and marginal farmers; 55% to 60% for general landholding farmers.
eligibility: Farmers in MP possessing agricultural land with access to a functional water source
application_mode: Online via MP Horticulture Portal (e-Anudan)

scheme_name: MP Baliraja Khet Talab Yojana (Farm Pond Scheme)
description: Provides financial assistance to build farm ponds (Khet Talab) on private land to catch monsoon rainwater and recharge groundwater.
benefits: Up to 50% financial grant (capped between ₹80,000 and ₹1,20,000 based on pond dimension and lining type).
eligibility: Individual farmers in MP owning at least 0.5 hectares of land
application_mode: Online via e-Anudan Portal / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Natural Farming Promotion Scheme (MP)
description: Encourages cow-based chemical-free natural farming, incentivizing farmers to adopt Jeevamrut, Beejamrut, and indigenous seed cultivation.
benefits: Monthly stipend of ₹900 (total ₹10,800 annually) for indigenous cow upkeep and 75% subsidy on natural farming input kits.
eligibility: Farmers in MP practicing verified natural farming on minimum 0.25 acres
Must own at least one indigenous cow
application_mode: Online via MP Natural Farming Portal / Gram Sevak

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Krishak Jeevan Kalyan Yojana
description: Provides immediate financial relief and compensation to farming families in the event of accidental death or severe injury during agricultural work.
benefits: Ex-gratia grant of ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or permanent total disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial disability.
eligibility: Farmers, farm laborers, and landless agricultural workers in MP aged 18 to 70 years
application_mode: Offline via Tehsil Office / District Collectorate

scheme_name: MP State Horticulture Development Scheme
description: Subsidizes high-value fruit orchard establishment, polyhouse/shade net installation, and high-tech nursery development.
benefits: 50% capital grant on high-density fruit planting material, polyhouse setup, and drip system integration.
eligibility: Farmers in MP converting traditional crop fields into fruit or vegetable cultivation
application_mode: Online via MP FSTS Horticulture Portal

scheme_name: MP Acharya Vidyasagar Dairy Chhatra Yojana
description: Assists smallholders and unemployed rural youth in setting up modern dairy units with high-yielding milch cows or buffaloes.
benefits: Up to 25% subsidy for General category and 33.33% for SC/ST category (capped up to ₹1,50,000 to ₹2,00,000 per dairy unit).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and landless farmers in MP establishing a minimum unit of 5 to 10 milch cattle
application_mode: Offline via District Veterinary / Animal Husbandry Department

scheme_name: Namo Shetkari Maha Sanman Nidhi Yojana
description: A state government initiative created to supplement PM-KISAN by providing an additional annual financial grant to landholding farmers across Maharashtra to support seasonal cultivation costs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year distributed in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into the beneficiary's bank account (combining with PM-KISAN for a total of ₹12,000/year).
eligibility: Resident farmers of Maharashtra
Registered and active beneficiaries of PM-KISAN
Valid Aadhaar-linked bank account with AEPS enabled
application_mode: Online via MahaDBT Portal

scheme_name: Nanaji Deshmukh Krishi Sanjivani Yojana (PoCRA)
description: A World Bank-assisted project focused on promoting climate-resilient agriculture in drought-prone and climate-vulnerable districts (specifically Marathwada and Vidarbha) through water management, soil health, and sustainable farming.
benefits: 75% to 100% financial subsidies on drip/sprinkler irrigation, farm ponds, shade net houses, and organic soil conditioners.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers in notified climate-vulnerable villages of Maharashtra
Land ownership recorded in 7/12 extract
documents: Caste Certificate (if applicable for higher subsidy tier)
application_mode: Online (PoCRA Portal / App)

scheme_name: Magel Tyala Shettale (Farm Ponds Scheme)
description: Ensures that every eligible farmer who requests a farm pond receives financial assistance to construct one, assisting in rainwater harvesting and drought mitigation.
benefits: Direct capital grant subsidy of up to ₹50,000 for constructing lined farm ponds.
eligibility: Farmers owning a minimum of 0.60 hectares of land
Feasible location for rainwater storage on land
application_mode: Online via MahaDBT

scheme_name: Magel Tyala Saur Krishi Pump Yojana
description: Provides off-grid solar-powered irrigation pumps to farmers, ensuring reliable daytime power supply for crop irrigation and reducing reliance on conventional power grids.
benefits: Up to 90% to 95% subsidy on 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP solar agriculture pump sets; farmers pay only 5% to 10% of total cost.
eligibility: Farmers with valid land records and access to a permanent water source (well/borewell)
Farmers without existing grid electricity connections for irrigation
documents: No-Objection Certificate (NOC) for shared water source if applicable
application_mode: Online via MSEDCL Portal / MahaDBT

scheme_name: Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Krushi Swavalamban Yojana
description: Targeted scheme aimed at socio-economic uplifting of Scheduled Caste (SC) and Neo-Buddhist farmers by upgrading their land infrastructure, irrigation capacity, and farm electrification.
benefits: Subsidies up to ₹4 Lakh for new wells, ₹1 Lakh for well repairs, and 100% subsidies for micro-irrigation and pump sets.
eligibility: Farmers belonging to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Neo-Buddhist categories in Maharashtra
Landholding between 0.20 hectares and 6 hectares
application_mode: Online via MahaDBT

scheme_name: Birsa Munda Krishi Kranti Yojana
description: A dedicated welfare scheme created for Scheduled Tribe (ST) farmers to improve agricultural production through irrigation assets, micro-irrigation, and soil treatment grants.
benefits: Subsidies up to ₹2.5 Lakh for new dug wells, along with additional grants for pump sets, plastic lining for farm ponds, and power connection setup.
eligibility: Farmers belonging to Scheduled Tribe (ST) community residing in Maharashtra
Landholding between 0.20 hectares and 6 hectares
application_mode: Online via MahaDBT

scheme_name: Mahatma Jyotiba Phule Shetkari Karj Mukti Yojana
description: Provides crop loan waivers to distressed farmers across Maharashtra who have overdue short-term crop loans, relieving their financial burden and restoring credit eligibility.
benefits: Direct loan waiver of up to ₹2 Lakh for short-term crop loans, directly settling accounts with participating banks.
eligibility: Farmers who took short-term crop loans from scheduled or cooperative banks in Maharashtra
Overdue or defaulted loan accounts meeting state cutoff criteria
application_mode: CSC Centers / Bank Branches (Aadhaar Biometric Verification)

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM) - Maharashtra
description: Encourages farm mechanization by providing subsidies on tractors, power tillers, rotavators, harvest equipment, and spray drones through a transparent lottery system.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹2.4 Lakh for mini-tractors and equipment; up to ₹4 Lakh for agricultural drones to FPOs).
eligibility: Individual farmers, Women farmers, SC/ST farmers, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
Must not have received equipment subsidy in the past 10 years
application_mode: Online via MahaDBT

scheme_name: Integrated Livestock & Poultry Development Program
description: Provides financial aid to rural, landless, and marginal farmers for setting up small-scale livestock units (milch cows, goats, and poultry) to generate supplementary household income.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing indigenous/crossbred milch cows, goat/sheep rearing units (10+1 breed units), or 100 day-old chicks setups.
eligibility: BPL families, landless agricultural laborers, women SHGs, and small landholders in rural Maharashtra
application_mode: Online via Department of Animal Husbandry Portal

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY - Organic Cluster Grant)
description: Promotes organic farming practices through cluster-based models by supporting vermicomposting, bio-fertilizer infrastructure, and organic certification for high-value export crops.
benefits: Financial aid of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for cluster farmers (covering vermicompost units, organic inputs, and PGS certification).
eligibility: Farmers willing to form clusters of a minimum 50 members and convert land to organic farming
application_mode: Group Application via District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Organic Oil Palm Mission (MOOPM)
description: Promotes commercial oil palm plantation across designated foothills and valley regions to boost edible oil production and diversify traditional shifting (jhum) cultivation.
benefits: 100% subsidy on high-yielding oil palm planting material (saplings), inter-cropping assistance of ₹5,200 per hectare, and maintenance allowance over 4 years.
eligibility: Farmers owning or holding community land rights in notified oil palm districts of Manipur
Registration on the State Horticulture & Agriculture Portal is required
documents: Land Ownership Certificate / Tribal Village Chief Land Authorization
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Officer or Online Portal

scheme_name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER-Manipur)
description: Focuses on developing certified organic crop clusters for niche regional crops like Black Rice (Chak-Hao), Kachai Lemon, Sirarakhong Chili, and Ginger.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹45,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, quality planting material, free Third-Party PGS/NPOP organic certification, and value-addition infrastructure.
eligibility: Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs), and individual growers operating in certified organic clusters in Manipur
documents: Land Document or Village Authority Certificate
application_mode: Offline through District Agriculture / MOMA (Manipur Organic Mission Agency) Offices

scheme_name: Manipur Horticulture Development Scheme (Protected Cultivation & Polyhouse)
description: Supports construction of tubular polyhouses, shade nets, and anti-hail nets for off-season vegetable farming and floriculture (orchids, gerbera) in hill and valley districts.
benefits: 50% to 75% capital subsidy for polyhouse and shade net construction, plus subsidized micro-irrigation kits.
eligibility: Horticulture growers, smallholders, and self-help groups in Manipur with suitable land access
documents: Land Record Extract or Village Chief Land Allotment Letter
application_mode: Offline via District Officer (Horticulture & Soil Conservation)

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Manipur)
description: Provides financial subsidies on small farm machinery designed for terrace, valley, and hilly terrains, including power tillers, brush cutters, paddy reapers, and mini-tractors.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for SC/ST/Women/Small farmers on individual tools and up to 80% subsidy for setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) by SHGs.
eligibility: Farmers owning or operating agricultural land in Manipur, registered SHGs, and cooperatives
documents: Land Ownership Certificate / Village Authority Verification
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Pukhri / Community Water Tank Construction Scheme (Jal Shakti Convergence)
description: Supports excavation of individual farm ponds (Pukhri) and water storage tanks in hilly and valley areas to ensure life-saving irrigation for winter crops.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹1,50,000 for excavating lined farm ponds and water collection structures under MGNREGA and Agriculture convergence.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding cultivable land in Manipur
documents: Land Ownership Document or Village Chief Certificate
application_mode: Offline via Gram Panchayat / Village Authority / Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Backyard Poultry & Piggery Mission
description: Encourages rural households and tribal farmers to adopt scientific backyard piggery and poultry rearing to boost meat self-sufficiency and farm income.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing piglets/day-old chicks, high-protein feed, night shelters, and free animal vaccination coverage.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Manipur, priority given to SC/ST households, BPL families, and Women SHGs
application_mode: Offline via Veterinary & Animal Husbandry Department / District Offices

scheme_name: Integrated Oak Tasar & Mulberry Sericulture Scheme
description: Leverages Manipur's unique agro-climate for Oak Tasar, Mulberry, and Eri silk production by subsidizing rearing equipment, food-plant plantations, and rearing sheds.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹1,20,000 for silkworm rearing shed construction, free supply of Oak Tasar / Mulberry saplings, and subsidized silkworm dfts/seeds.
eligibility: Traditional silk rearers, farm women, and tribal households in Manipur with land for host plants
documents: Land Availability Proof / Village Authority Certificate
application_mode: Offline via District Sericulture Officer / Directorate of Sericulture Manipur

scheme_name: Manipur Inland & Cage Aquaculture Promotion Scheme
description: Promotes inland fish culture in ponds, circular tanks (Biofloc), and floating cage culture in major lakes/reservoirs (e.g., Loktak Lake) to meet high local fish demand.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for SC/ST/Women on constructing new fish ponds, fingerlings, fish feed, and cage unit setups.
eligibility: Fishermen, fish farmers, and unemployed youth in Manipur with access to land or water bodies
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Officer or Online State Fisheries Portal

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Solar Irrigation Scheme - Manipur Component
description: Installs standalone solar-powered water pumping systems in off-grid and hilly agricultural regions where grid electricity access is limited.
benefits: Up to 80% combined central and state financial subsidy on standalone solar pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP capacity).
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land in Manipur with an active water source (stream, pond, well) lacking electricity
documents: Self-Declaration of No Grid Power at Pumping Site
application_mode: Offline via MANIREDA (Manipur Renewable Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Soil Health Card & Soil Conservation Scheme
description: Provides free soil testing and custom nutrient advice, along with terrace land development and contour bunding subsidies to check soil erosion on hill slopes.
benefits: Free Soil Health Card issued every 2 years, plus 80% subsidy for bench terracing and contour bunding construction on hill slopes.
eligibility: All farmers practicing hill or valley agriculture in Manipur
documents: Land Record / Village Authority Land Identity
application_mode: Offline via District Soil Conservation / Agriculture Extension Center

scheme_name: FOCUS (Farmers’ Collectivization for Upscaling Production and Marketing System)
description: Meghalaya's flagship flagship farmer support program designed to organize small and marginal farmers into Producer Groups (PGs) and provide seed capital to scale up farming, processing, and direct market access.
benefits: Direct seed capital grant of ₹5,000 per member (up to ₹1,00,000 per Producer Group) deposited into the group's bank account for agri-business operations.
eligibility: Farmers residing in Meghalaya organized into registered Producer Groups (10 to 20 members)
Must be registered on the Meghviman / FOCUS portal
documents: Aadhaar Card Copy of all members
Joint Bank Account Details of the Producer Group
application_mode: Online via FOCUS Portal (focus.mbda.gov.in) / Offline through District BDO Office

scheme_name: Meghalaya Lakadong Turmeric Mission
category: GI Tag Crop Promotion & Value Addition
description: Dedicated mission to expand cultivation, quality processing, and export of the world-famous high-curcumin Lakadong Turmeric grown primarily in the Jaintia Hills region.
benefits: Free distribution of high-yielding Lakadong turmeric seed rhizomes, 75% subsidy on solar turmeric driers and washing equipment, and direct market buyback linkages.
eligibility: Traditional and new turmeric growers, SHGs, and Producer Groups in West & East Jaintia Hills and surrounding notified districts
documents: Land Possession Certificate or Headman Certificate
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / MBDA Offices

scheme_name: Meghalaya Ginger Development Mission
description: Aims to increase ginger yield, eliminate disease in seed ginger, and build processing facilities to produce ginger powder, oil, and candy for export.
benefits: Subsidized disease-free organic seed ginger, 50% subsidy on ginger processing and washing machines, and free organic certification.
eligibility: Farmers and farmer cooperatives in major ginger-growing districts like Ri-Bhoi, West Garo Hills, and East Khasi Hills
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / MBDA Office

scheme_name: Meghalaya Piggery Mission (Pork Self-Sufficiency Scheme)
description: A major initiative funded in partnership with NCDC to achieve self-sufficiency in pork production by supporting commercial pig breeding, fattening, and processing units.
benefits: Interest-free / highly subsidized loans, up to 50% capital grant for establishing 3-sow or 10-sow pig breeding units, plus free pig insurance and vaccination.
eligibility: Permanent residents of Meghalaya, Cooperative Societies, Producer Groups, and individual livestock farmers
documents: Land Availability Proof or Headman Certificate for Pig Shed
application_mode: Offline via District AH & Veterinary Officer / Meghalaya Livestock Enterprises Federation

scheme_name: Meghalaya Mushroom Mission
description: Promotes commercial mushroom farming (Oyster, Button, Shiitake) to augment farm incomes, combat malnutrition, and create year-round employment.
benefits: 75% subsidy on mushroom spawn production units, substrate preparation units, and climate-controlled mushroom cultivation sheds.
eligibility: Smallholders, landless laborers, women SHGs, and rural youth residing in Meghalaya
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer / Mushroom Development Center Shillong

scheme_name: Meghalaya Honey Mission (Apiculture Promotion)
description: Supports scientific apiculture to produce pure forest and wildflower honey, boosting crop pollination and generating supplementary rural livelihoods.
benefits: 80% subsidy on scientific bee boxes, colonies, honey extraction equipment, and free technical training provided by the Commerce & Industries / Agriculture Dept.
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural youth, and SHGs residing in Meghalaya
application_mode: Offline via District Commerce & Industries Centre (DCIC) / District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Meghalaya)
description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, power weeders, mini-tractors, and brush cutters tailored for Meghalaya's hilly terrace topography.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual tribal farmers and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) by Producer Groups.
eligibility: Farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land in Meghalaya, SHGs, and registered Producer Groups
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Officer (DAO)

scheme_name: Meghalaya Integrated Aquaculture Development Project (Fish Mission)
description: Promotes fish farming in individual and community ponds, high-altitude trout culture, and paddy-cum-fish culture to meet regional fish demand.
benefits: 60% to 75% capital subsidy for excavating new fish ponds, fingerlings, fish feed, and water quality testing kits.
eligibility: Landowners, farmer groups, and unemployed youth in Meghalaya with suitable land and water sources
documents: Land Possession Certificate / Village Headman NOC
Site Inspection Report by Fisheries Officer
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO)

scheme_name: Protected Cultivation & Polyhouse Scheme (Meghalaya Horticulture)
description: Encourages off-season vegetable growing (capsicum, tomato, cucumber) and cut flowers (carnations, gerbera) under polyhouses and shade-net structures.
benefits: 50% to 70% capital grant for installing tubular polyhouse structures, drip irrigation systems, and high-yielding seeds.
eligibility: Horticulture farmers and Producer Groups in Meghalaya with permanent water and land access
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / MBDA

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Water Pumping Scheme (Meghalaya Component)
description: Installs standalone solar-powered pumpsets in off-grid hilly agricultural areas to ensure reliable irrigation for high-value horticulture crops.
benefits: Up to 85% total subsidy (combined central and state funds) on standalone solar pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Meghalaya with access to surface water or open wells lacking grid power
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing Electric Pump Connection
application_mode: Offline via MNREDA (Meghalaya Non-Conventional and Rural Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Bana Lutu / Handholding Scheme (formerly SEDP Agriculture)
description: The flagship program of the Government of Mizoram aimed at transforming rural livelihoods by offering financial grants, technical guidance, and direct marketing support to settled agricultural households.
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹50,000 per selected family for input purchases, crop diversification, and setting up small agro-enterprises.
eligibility: Permanent resident agricultural households of Mizoram practicing settled farming
Priority given to BPL families transitioning away from slash-and-burn (Jhum) cultivation
documents: Voter ID / Domicile Certificate of Mizoram
Village Council Letter / Land Settlement Certificate (LSC)
application_mode: Offline via Village Council Development Committee (VCDC) / Block Development Office

scheme_name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER-Mizoram)
description: Develops certified organic commodity clusters for signature regional crops like Mizo Chili (Bird's Eye Chili), Ginger, Turmeric, and Passion Fruit.
benefits: Financial grant of ₹45,000 per hectare spread over 3 years for organic seeds/inputs, free group NPOP/PGS organic certification, and processing equipment subsidies.
eligibility: Farmers registered under Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs) or Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) in designated organic clusters in Mizoram
application_mode: Offline via Mizoram Organic Mission (MOM) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Mizoram Oil Palm Cultivation Mission
description: Promotes oil palm plantations across suitable low-altitude hill slopes and valley areas to boost farmer incomes and replace unstable shifting cultivation.
benefits: 100% subsidy on high-yielding oil palm sprouts/saplings, maintenance subsidy of ₹5,200 per hectare per year for 4 years, and guaranteed fresh fruit bunch (FFB) buyback.
eligibility: Farmers holding suitable land with LSC or Village Council Allotment in designated oil palm districts of Mizoram
application_mode: Offline through District Agriculture Officer (DAO) / Oil Palm Processing Partner Offices

scheme_name: Integrated Horticulture Development Scheme (Polyhouse & Floriculture)
description: Encourages commercial flower cultivation (Anthurium, Cymbidium Orchids) and off-season vegetable farming under polyhouses and shade nets.
benefits: 50% to 75% capital subsidy for installing polyhouses, shade-net structures, and micro-irrigation systems, along with subsidized high-value planting material.
eligibility: Horticulture farmers and women SHGs residing in Mizoram with dedicated land and water access
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Directorate of Horticulture

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Mizoram)
description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, brush cutters, mini-paddy threshers, and power weeders engineered specifically for Mizoram's steep terrain.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual smallholders and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) operated by SHGs/Cooperatives.
eligibility: Farmers owning or cultivating agricultural land in Mizoram, registered SHGs, and cooperatives
documents: Equipment Proforma Invoice from Authorized Dealer
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Backyard Piggery & Poultry Development Scheme
description: Provides high-quality piglet breeding stock, day-old chicks, and feed subsidies to rural families to support meat self-sufficiency and family income.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing piglets/chicks, construction of pig/poultry shelters, and free animal vaccination/deworming support.
eligibility: Permanent resident families of Mizoram with space for livestock rearing
application_mode: Offline via District AH & Veterinary Officer / AH&Veti Department

scheme_name: Mizoram Dragon Fruit & Tropical Fruits Promotion Scheme
description: Supports the expansion of high-value tropical fruits like Dragon Fruit, Passion Fruit, and Mandarin Orange across well-drained hill slopes.
benefits: Subsidy up to ₹1,20,000 per hectare for concrete trellis installation, planting material, and drip irrigation setup.
eligibility: Land-owning farmers in Mizoram registering for fresh fruit orchard establishment
documents: Field Inspection Report by Horticulture Officer
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Mizoram Fish Farmer Development Agency (FFDA) Pond Scheme
description: Supports construction of new fish ponds, renovation of existing ponds, and paddy-cum-fish culture in plain and valley areas.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General category and 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women on constructing new fish ponds, purchasing fish seed, and fish feed.
eligibility: Individual farmers, youth groups, and cooperatives in Mizoram owning suitable land with perennial water sources
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO)

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Pumpset Scheme (Mizoram Component)
description: Provides standalone solar-powered water pumpsets to farmers on remote hill slopes where conventional electricity grid connection is absent.
benefits: Up to 85% financial subsidy (combined central and state grant) on standalone solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP capacity).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Mizoram with access to streams, rivers, or open wells lacking grid power
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing Electric Pump Connection
application_mode: Offline via ZEDA (Zoram Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Sloping Agricultural Land Technology (SALT) & Soil Conservation Scheme
description: Promotes SALT farming techniques, contour hedgerows, and bench terracing to prevent soil erosion, retain soil nutrients, and restore degraded hill slopes.
benefits: 80% financial subsidy for constructing terraced fields, contour bunding, and planting nitrogen-fixing hedgerow plants.
eligibility: Farmers practicing hill slope farming in Mizoram
application_mode: Offline via District Officer (Directorate of Soil & Water Conservation)

scheme_name: Nagaland Agro-Forestry & Coffee Expansion Mission
description: A major initiative in partnership with the Coffee Board of India to promote shade-grown Arabica and Robusta coffee plantations across hill slopes, offering sustainable livelihoods as an alternative to jhum (shifting) cultivation.
benefits: Free high-quality coffee saplings, financial support of ₹30,000 per hectare spread over 3 years for maintenance, and 75% subsidy on coffee pulping machines.
eligibility: Traditional jhum farmers, SHGs, and land-owning tribal households in Nagaland
Must have suitable shade-canopy land on hill slopes recommended by Land Resources Department
documents: Indigenous Inhabitant Certificate / Resident Certificate of Nagaland
Village Council Land Ownership / Authorization Certificate
application_mode: Offline via District Land Resources Officer (DLRO) / Directorate of Land Resources

scheme_name: Mission Organic Value Chain Development for North Eastern Region (MOVCDNER-Nagaland)
description: Develops commercial organic value chains for signature crops like Naga King Chili (Raja Mircha), Naga Sweet Cucumber, Ginger, Turmeric, and Organic Maize.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹45,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, free Third-Party PGS/NPOP organic certification, and processing unit subsidies.
eligibility: Farmers, Farmer Interest Groups (FIGs), and Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs) operating in notified organic clusters in Nagaland
application_mode: Offline via District Agriculture Officer (DAO) / NOAM (Nagaland Organic Mission)

scheme_name: Nagaland Honey Mission (Apiculture Promotion)
description: Promotes scientific apiculture for stingless and Rock/Apis cerana bees, leveraging Nagaland's rich floral diversity to produce premium wildflower honey.
benefits: 80% subsidy on scientific bee boxes, swarm catchers, and extraction equipment, alongside free training by the Nagaland Honey and Beekeeping Mission (NHBM).
eligibility: Individual farmers, rural youth, and SHGs residing in Nagaland
application_mode: Offline via Nagaland Honey & Beekeeping Mission (NHBM) Offices / Team Metamorphosis

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Nagaland)
description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, brush cutters, paddy harvesters, and terracing tools designed for Nagaland's hilly and terrace farming conditions.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual smallholders and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) operated by SHGs/Village Councils.
eligibility: Farmers owning or operating land in Nagaland, registered SHGs, and Village Council Cooperatives
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Micro-Finance Initiative (CMMFI - Agriculture Wing)
description: Provides affordable credit and capital subsidies to farmers, SHGs, and agri-entrepreneurs for setting up greenhouses, cold stores, processing units, and farm machinery.
benefits: 30% capital subsidy from state government, 60% bank loan with 4% interest subvention, and only 10% beneficiary contribution.
eligibility: Permanent resident farmers, SHGs, Joint Liability Groups, and Farmers Producer Organizations in Nagaland
application_mode: Offline via District Level Implementation Committee (DLIC) headed by Deputy Commissioner

scheme_name: Integrated Horticulture Development Scheme (Polyhouse & Kiwi Mission)
description: Supports commercial cultivation of Kiwi fruit, Naga Cucumber, Dragon Fruit, and off-season vegetables under tubular polyhouses and shade nets.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on polyhouse construction, micro-irrigation systems, and high-yielding kiwi/fruit saplings.
eligibility: Horticulture growers, smallholders, and SHGs residing in Nagaland with land and water availability
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Directorate of Horticulture

scheme_name: Backyard Piggery & Livestock Development Mission
description: Supports rural households in establishing modern pig breeding and fattening units to meet local pork demand and increase household cash flow.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on high-quality piglets, pig feed, pig shelter construction, and free swine fever vaccination.
eligibility: Permanent resident households of Nagaland with space for piggery management
application_mode: Offline via District Veterinary & Animal Husbandry Officer

scheme_name: Nagaland Fisheries & Aqua-Park Promotion Scheme
description: Encourages fish culture in paddy fields (paddy-cum-fish culture), construction of new fish ponds, and high-altitude trout farming in cold-water streams.
benefits: 40% subsidy for General and 60% for SC/ST/Women on constructing new fish ponds, fish seed, and feed inputs.
eligibility: Fish farmers, youth groups, and village cooperatives in Nagaland owning land with suitable water supply
documents: Village Council Land Allotment / NOC Certificate
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Development Officer (DFDO)

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Pumping Scheme (Nagaland Component)
description: Installs standalone solar-powered water pumpsets in off-grid hilly agricultural areas to ensure reliable life-saving irrigation for winter crops.
benefits: Up to 85% combined central and state financial subsidy on standalone solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Nagaland with access to surface water or wells lacking conventional grid electricity
documents: Self-Declaration of No Grid Connection at Pumping Site
application_mode: Offline via NEDA (Nagaland Renewable Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Terrace Rice Cultivation (TRC) & Soil Conservation Scheme
description: Promotes settled Terrace Rice Cultivation (TRC) on hill slopes through bench terracing, water harvesting ponds, and contour bunding to prevent soil erosion.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹20,000 per hectare for bench terrace construction, plus free distribution of high-yielding paddy seeds.
eligibility: Farmers transitioning from jhum to settled terrace cultivation in Nagaland
application_mode: Offline via District Soil & Water Conservation Officer

scheme_name: KALIA (Krushak Assistance for Livelihood and Income Augmentation)
description: A comprehensive welfare package designed to accelerate agricultural prosperity and reduce poverty by providing direct financial support to farmers and landless agricultural households.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000 per year (₹5,000 each for Kharif and Rabi seasons) for cultivators, plus ₹12,500 one-time support for landless agricultural households for allied activities.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding up to 2 hectares of cultivable land in Odisha
Landless agricultural households and vulnerable farming families
Must not be an institutional landholder or tax-paying citizen
documents: Land Holding Document (RoR) / Krushak Odisha ID
application_mode: Online via KALIA / Krushak Odisha Portal

scheme_name: BALARAM Scheme
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit to sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and landless agricultural workers through Joint Liability Groups (JLGs).
benefits: Collateral-free, interest-subsidized crop loans up to ₹50,000 per season per group member.
eligibility: Landless sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and agricultural workers in Odisha
Must form Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) consisting of 4 to 5 members
application_mode: Offline via Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) / Local Banks

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Krushi Udyog Yojana (MKUY)
description: Incentivizes commercial agricultural and allied enterprises by offering substantial capital investment subsidies to individual farmers and entrepreneurs.
benefits: Capital Investment Subsidy (CIS) of 40% to 50% (up to ₹50 lakh) on the fixed capital cost of setting up eligible agri-enterprises.
eligibility: Agri-entrepreneurs, individual farmers, and self-help groups (SHGs) in Odisha
SC/ST, women, and agricultural graduates receive higher subsidy caps (50%)
application_mode: Online via APICOL / Sujog Portal

scheme_name: Odisha Millet Mission (Shree Anna Abhiyan)
description: Promotes the cultivation, processing, and consumption of climate-resilient millets across rainfed and tribal agricultural regions.
benefits: Incentive cash transfers up to ₹12,000/hectare spread over 3 years, free seed kits, processing machinery grants, and assured procurement at MSP.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating millets (ragi, foxtail, jowar) in designated project blocks of Odisha
application_mode: Online via Krushak Odisha Portal / Block Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Biju Krushak Kalyan Yojana (BKKY)
description: A state-supported agricultural risk mitigation scheme providing financial protection against yield losses caused by natural disasters and pest infestations.
benefits: 100% state-funded crop insurance providing coverage up to ₹30,000 per hectare for major food crops.
eligibility: All registered landholding and tenant farmers in Odisha cultivating notified crops
application_mode: Online via Krushak Odisha Portal

scheme_name: Odisha Farm Mechanization Scheme
description: Subsidizes modern agricultural implements to reduce labor dependence, lower cultivation costs, and increase crop productivity.
benefits: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy ranging from 40% to 75% on tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and harvesters.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land in Odisha registered on the Agrinet portal
application_mode: Online via Odisha Agrinet / DBT Agriculture Portal

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana - Odisha Organic Mission
description: Encourages cluster-based organic farming practices, soil rejuvenation, and eco-friendly agricultural inputs.
benefits: Financial support up to ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years for organic inputs, vermicompost units, and organic certification.
eligibility: Farmers forming organic clusters of minimum 20 hectares in designated districts
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / Cluster Representative

scheme_name: Chief Minister Adibandh Scheme
description: Constructs check dams across minor streams to conserve surface water and provide critical irrigation to surrounding farmlands.
benefits: 100% government-funded development of local water harvesting check dams providing gravity flow or lift irrigation.
eligibility: Community farming groups and farmers in water-stressed or rainfed areas of Odisha
application_mode: Offline via Executive Engineer (Minor Irrigation) / Pani Panchayat

scheme_name: Odisha Dairy & Livestock Livelihood Support
description: Supports smallholders and women SHGs in establishing dairy units, boosting milk production, and creating sustainable rural livelihoods.
benefits: 50% to 75% subsidy on purchasing milch cows/buffaloes, cattle shed construction, and fodder cultivation.
eligibility: Individual farmers, landless laborers, and women SHG members in Odisha
application_mode: Online via Chief District Veterinary Office / OMFED Portal

scheme_name: Utkalika Artisan & Cottage Agro-Industry Support
description: Empowers traditional rural artisans and agro-based cottage craft workers through toolkit grants and direct market access.
benefits: Grants up to ₹50,000 for modern machinery toolkits, stipend for skill upgradation, and listing on state e-commerce portals.
eligibility: Registered rural artisans and agro-cottage workers residing in Odisha
application_mode: Offline via District Industries Center (DIC) / Utkalika

scheme_name: Production Incentive / Back-Ended Subsidy for Horticulture Crops
description: Offers direct financial incentives to farmers growing fruit trees, vegetables, and perennial crops to cover input costs.
benefits: ₹12,250 for Mango, ₹5,830 for Guava, up to ₹18,750 for winter vegetables, and ₹7,500/ha for coconut per year.
eligibility: Landowners and tenant farmers in Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam with Farmer ID Cards
application_mode: Offline via Uzhavar Udhaviyagam (Farmers' Help Centres) / Online via State Portal

scheme_name: Production Incentive for Paddy Cultivation (Traditional & Conventional)
description: Provides per-acre direct cash support to paddy farmers to cushion rising cultivation costs and promote native high-yielding seeds.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer (DBT) per hectare financial incentive credited directly into farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Paddy growers registered with the Department of Agriculture, UT Puducherry
application_mode: Online via Puducherry Agri Portal / Uzhavar Udhaviyagam

scheme_name: Subsidy Registration for Millet & Groundnut Cultivation
description: Promotes rainfed oilseeds and millet crops by subsidizing certified seed cost, pest protection, and micro-nutrients.
benefits: 50% seed cost subsidy and input kit grants for groundnut and millet crops.
eligibility: All practicing farmers in Puducherry UT
application_mode: Online via National/State Services Portal

scheme_name: Puducherry Agricultural Machinery & Equipment Subsidy
description: Provides financial support for purchasing tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and brush cutters.
benefits: 50% subsidy on farm implements (up to ₹1,000,000 max depending on machine category).
eligibility: Individual farmers, registered farmer groups, and agri-entrepreneurs in Puducherry
application_mode: Offline via Additional Director of Agriculture (Mechanization)

scheme_name: Drip and Sprinkler Micro-Irrigation Assistance Scheme
description: Encourages water-saving drip and sprinkler irrigation installations for sugarcane, coconut, and horticultural crops.
benefits: 75% to 100% subsidy on installation of micro-irrigation systems for small/marginal farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivated land with accessible water sources in Puducherry, Karaikal, or Yanam
application_mode: Offline via Uzhavar Udhaviyagam

scheme_name: Subsidy Registration for Fodder Crop Cultivation
description: Encourages farmers to dedicate land to green fodder development (Co-4, Napier grass) to support local dairy production.
benefits: Financial assistance per hectare for green fodder planting seed kits and field maintenance.
eligibility: Farmers owning cattle and cultivating fodder crops in UT Puducherry
application_mode: Online / Offline via Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

scheme_name: Puducherry Soil Health & Organic Farming Incentive
description: Promotes green manuring, soil testing, and application of bio-fertilizers and neem-coated inputs.
benefits: Free soil testing cards + 50% subsidy on organic manure, bio-agents, and green manure seeds.
eligibility: All resident farmers in UT Puducherry
application_mode: Offline via Local Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Roof-Top Vegetable Gardening Kit Subsidy Scheme
description: Distributes subsidized urban garden kits containing grow bags, seeds, coco-peat, and bio-pesticides for rooftop vegetable farming.
benefits: 75% subsidy on mini rooftop vegetable gardening kits.
eligibility: Urban and semi-urban households residing in Puducherry UT
application_mode: Offline via Botanical Garden / Agriculture Department Outlets

scheme_name: Precision Farming Scheme for High-Value Crops
description: Promotes high-tech polyhouses, shade-net houses, and precision farming for flowers and exotic vegetables.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for erecting shade net structures and polyhouses.
eligibility: Progressive farmers and agri-entrepreneurs in Puducherry UT
application_mode: Offline via Deputy Director of Agriculture (Horticulture)

scheme_name: Puducherry Crop Insurance Price Stabilization Scheme
description: State share subsidy for crop insurance premiums and relief assistance during natural disasters like cyclones.
benefits: 100% premium subsidy for small/marginal farmers under PMFBY and direct relief grants.
eligibility: Farmers affected by natural disasters or enrolled under crop insurance in Puducherry
application_mode: Offline via Revenue / Agriculture Department

scheme_name: Crop Residue Management (CRM) Scheme
description: A high-priority initiative in Punjab aimed at curbing stubble burning (paddy straw) by subsidizing in-situ and ex-situ crop residue management machinery like Happy Seeders, Super Seeders, Paddy Straw Choppers, and Balers.
benefits: 50% subsidy for individual farmers and 80% subsidy for Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs), Panchayats, and Farmers Cooperative Societies on approved straw management machinery.
eligibility: Individual farmers owning agricultural land in Punjab
Registered Farmers Cooperative Societies, Panchayats, and FPOs in Punjab
application_mode: Online via Punjab Agripmachinery Portal

scheme_name: Mukh Mantri Khet Sadak Yojana
description: A state infrastructure project designed to repair, widen, and pave rural link roads connecting agricultural fields to local grain markets (Mandis) to facilitate seamless crop transportation.
benefits: State-funded construction and repair of rural agricultural link roads, reducing transport time and crop spillage loss.
eligibility: Community/Panchayat-level infrastructure initiative benefiting all regional farmers in Punjab
application_mode: Offline via Punjab Mandi Board / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Pani Bachao, Paisa Kamao (PBPK)
description: An innovative voluntary incentive scheme that encourages farmers to conserve groundwater and electricity by offering cash rewards for consuming less electricity than their allocated farm limit for tubewells.
benefits: Direct cash transfer of ₹4 per kilowatt-hour (unit) of electricity saved compared to the baseline allocation.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab with metered agricultural tubewell electricity connections
documents: PSPCL Electricity Connection / Meter Account Number
application_mode: Online / PSPCL (Punjab State Power Corporation Limited) Offices

scheme_name: Direct Sowing of Rice (DSR) Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes direct seeding of rice instead of traditional nursery transplantation to drastically reduce groundwater consumption and labor requirements during Kharif sowing.
benefits: Direct financial incentive of ₹1,500 per acre paid directly into the farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab adopting the Direct Sowing of Rice (DSR) technique on their lands
Verification completed by local Agriculture Extension Officers
application_mode: Online via AgriPunjab Portal

scheme_name: Punjab Horticulture Crop Insurance Scheme
description: A state scheme providing targeted risk coverage for fruit and vegetable growers against adverse weather conditions, unseasonal rains, hail, and disease outbreaks.
benefits: Financial compensation up to ₹15,000 to ₹40,000 per acre depending on the specific horticultural crop damaged.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating notified fruit and vegetable crops in Punjab
application_mode: Online / District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Seeds and Planting Material (SMSP) - Punjab
description: Provides high-quality, certified seeds for wheat, paddy, pulses, and fodder crops at subsidized rates to raise crop yields and crop quality across the state.
benefits: 50% subsidy on the purchase of certified high-yielding seed varieties.
eligibility: All resident farmers registered on the Punjab Agriculture Department portal
application_mode: Online Portal / Punjab State Seeds Corporation (PUNSEED) Outlets

scheme_name: Punjab Dairy Development Board (PDDB) Capital Subsidy
description: Offers capital assistance for modernizing dairy units, purchasing high-yield milch cattle, and setting up automated milking machines and bulk milk coolers.
benefits: 25% subsidy for general category and 33.33% subsidy for SC category farmers on modern dairy unit setups (up to 20 cattle units).
eligibility: Farmers and unemployed youth residing in Punjab taking up dairy farming
Completion of basic dairy management training from PDDB
application_mode: Online / District Dairy Development Office

scheme_name: Punjab Micro-Irrigation Scheme (UGPIP)
description: Focuses on laying Underground Pipeline Systems (UGPIP) for efficient irrigation water distribution from canals and tubewells, eliminating conveyance water losses.
benefits: 90% subsidy for group/community projects and 50% for individual landholders laying underground irrigation pipelines.
eligibility: Individual landholders or groups of minimum 3 farmers sharing a water source in Punjab
application_mode: Online via Soil and Water Conservation Department Punjab

scheme_name: Promotion of Organic and Natural Farming - Punjab
description: Encourages farmers to transition land from chemical-intensive practices to certified organic and natural farming through input grants and eco-marketing aid.
benefits: Financial assistance up to ₹10,000 per acre spread over 3 years for organic inputs, soil testing, and certification.
eligibility: Farmers in Punjab dedicating a minimum of 1 acre of land to organic farming
application_mode: Offline via District Organic Farming Cell / Online Portal

scheme_name: Punjab Agricultural Insurance & Disaster Relief
description: Provides state compensation to farmers experiencing significant crop loss caused by floods, hail, pest outbreaks, or unexpected weather disruptions.
benefits: Direct compensation up to ₹15,000 per acre for 75% to 100% crop damage.
eligibility: Farmers in notified flood-affected or natural calamity-hit districts in Punjab
documents: Girdawari Report (Special Crop Loss Assessment by Revenue Dept)
application_mode: District Revenue Officer / Local Revenue Patwari verification

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
description: A state-level top-up income support program providing direct financial assistance to landholding farmers over and above the central PM-KISAN payouts.
benefits: Additional annual direct benefit transfer (DBT) assistance credited directly into the farmer's bank account in periodic installments.
eligibility: Resident landholding farmers of Rajasthan
Must be registered and verified under the PM-KISAN database with completed eKYC
documents: Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal / SSO ID

scheme_name: Rajasthan Tarbandi Yojana (Farm Fencing Subsidy)
description: Offers financial subsidies for boundary wire fencing to protect standing crops from damage caused by stray cattle, Nilgai (blue bulls), and wild animals.
benefits: 50% to 70% financial subsidy on fencing costs (up to a maximum of ₹48,000 for individual farmers or higher for group clusters up to 400 running meters).
eligibility: Individual farmers possessing at least 1.5 hectares of cultivable land in Rajasthan
Group of farmers (minimum 2 farmers) possessing combined contiguous land of 1.5 hectares or more
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: Rajasthan Diggi Construction Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides financial support to construct specialized water storage tanks (Diggis) in canal-irrigated regions to harvest water and ensure life-saving crop irrigation.
benefits: Financial grant up to 75% to 85% of total construction cost (capped at ₹3,00,000 to ₹3,40,000 based on capacity and category).
eligibility: Farmers owning at least 0.5 hectares of agricultural land in designated canal command areas of Rajasthan
documents: Canal Water Rights Certificate / Irrigation Receipt
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Component-B Solar Pump Scheme (Rajasthan)
description: Subsidizes off-grid solar-powered water pumping systems (3 HP to 10 HP) to provide clean, daylight irrigation and eliminate dependence on expensive diesel pumps.
benefits: Up to 60% total subsidy (30% Central + 30% State); farmer pays only 40% (or 10% with institutional financing).
