eligibility: Farmers with agricultural land having an active open well, borewell, or surface water source without grid power connection
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: Rajasthan Farm Pond (Khet Talai) Scheme
description: Promotes farm pond construction in rainfed regions to store monsoon runoff for supplementary irrigation during dry spells.
benefits: Up to 60% to 70% subsidy (capped between ₹63,000 and ₹1,35,000 depending on plastic lining and farmer category).
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Rajasthan with minimum 0.3 hectares of cultivable land
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: RajKisan Micro-Irrigation Scheme (Drip & Sprinkler)
description: Assists farmers in adopting modern drip, mini-sprinkler, and rain-gun irrigation systems to optimize water usage in hyper-arid zones.
benefits: 70% to 80% subsidy for small, marginal, and women farmers; 50% to 60% subsidy for general category farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivable land with a functional water source (borewell, diggi, or pond)
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: RajKisan Krishi Yantra Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides financial assistance for purchasing essential agricultural machinery such as rotavators, seed-cum-fertilizer drills, threshers, disc harrows, and chizel plows.
benefits: 40% to 50% capital subsidy (up to ₹15,000–₹1,00,000 depending on machine type and farmer category).
eligibility: Landholding farmers registered on the Raj Kisan Sathi portal in Rajasthan
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: Rajiv Gandhi Krishak Sathi Sahayata Yojana
description: Provides financial compensation to farmers and agricultural laborers in the event of accidental death or permanent disability while operating farm machinery or working in fields.
benefits: Financial ex-gratia grant of ₹2,00,000 in case of death or total disability; partial compensation ranging from ₹5,00,0 to ₹1,00,000 for limb/eye loss.
eligibility: Farmers, farm laborers, and mandi workers aged between 14 and 70 years residing in Rajasthan
documents: FIR / Post-Mortem Report (in case of accidental death)
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal / Krishi Upaj Mandi Office

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Beej Swavalamban Yojana
description: Encourages farmers to produce and use certified high-quality seeds of major field crops (wheat, gram, mustard, soybean, barley) on their own farms.
benefits: Free foundation/certified seed mini-kits and technical training on seed production and processing.
eligibility: Small, marginal, and progressive farmers cultivating major field crops in Rajasthan
application_mode: Raj Kisan Sathi Portal / Agriculture Extension Worker (Gram Panchayat)

scheme_name: Pipeline Subsidy Scheme for Irrigation
description: Offers subsidies for laying underground PVC/HDPE irrigation pipelines from the water source (well/borewell/diggi) directly to crop fields to prevent seepage and evaporation water losses.
benefits: 50% to 60% financial subsidy on pipe cost (up to a maximum of ₹18,000 to ₹20,000 or ₹50 per meter).
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Rajasthan with an operational water source
documents: Pipe Purchase GST Bill from authorized dealer
application_mode: Online via Raj Kisan Sathi Portal

scheme_name: Sikkim Garib Thekka Incentive Scheme (Production Incentive Scheme)
description: Provides direct financial cash incentives to local organic farmers based on the quantity of certified organic crops produced and sold through formal channels to boost rural incomes.
benefits: Direct cash incentive paid per kilogram for major crops like Large Cardamom (₹100/kg), Ginger (₹20/kg), Turmeric (₹10/kg), Buckwheat (₹10/kg), and Milk (₹8/liter).
eligibility: Organic farmers residing in Sikkim selling produce through recognized cooperatives, FPOs, or government procurement centers
Must hold Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification (CoI)
documents: Sikkim Subject Certificate / Certificate of Identification (CoI)
Produce Sale Receipt from FPO / Cooperative
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture / Agriculture Extension Officer or Local FPO

scheme_name: Sikkim Organic Mission & NPOP/PGS Certification Scheme
description: Maintains and expands Sikkim's status as India's 100% organic state by funding organic inputs, bio-pesticides, soil testing, and free organic re-certification.
benefits: Free supply of certified bio-fertilizers and bio-pesticides, zero-cost third-party NPOP/PGS organic certification, and training on vermicomposting.
eligibility: All practicing farmers and landholders operating agricultural land in Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via Block Agriculture Development Officer (ADO) / Sikkim Organic Mission Office

scheme_name: Integrated Horticulture Development Scheme (Polyhouse & Floriculture)
description: Supports commercial greenhouse cultivation of high-value orchids (Cymbidium), Gerbera, Rose, and off-season organic vegetables tailored for hill climates.
benefits: 50% to 75% capital subsidy for installing polyhouses, shade-net structures, drip irrigation systems, and purchasing disease-free tissue culture plantlets.
eligibility: Horticulture growers and registered SHGs in Sikkim with suitable land terrace access
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Officer (DHO) / Horticulture Department

scheme_name: Sikkim Large Cardamom Rejuvenation Mission
description: Aims to restore and expand high-yielding Large Cardamom plantations across hill districts by replacing disease-affected old bushes with certified virus-free suckers.
benefits: Financial assistance of up to ₹70,000 per hectare for trench digging, certified disease-free suckers, organic inputs, and eco-friendly cardamom curing kilns (Bhatti).
eligibility: Traditional cardamom growers and landowners in Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via District Horticulture Office / Spices Board Local Office

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM - Sikkim)
description: Provides financial subsidies on power tillers, brush cutters, mini-paddy threshers, and power weeders engineered specifically for terrace farming in mountain terrain.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy for individual smallholders and up to 80% subsidy for establishing Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) operated by SHGs/Cooperatives.
eligibility: Farmers owning or cultivating land in Sikkim, registered SHGs, and cooperatives
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / Offline via District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Chief Minister’s Livestock Development Incentive Scheme
description: Promotes high-yielding dairy farming, goat rearing, and backyard piggery by providing cattle purchase grants and milk production bonuses.
benefits: Direct cash bonus of ₹8 per liter of milk delivered to dairy cooperatives, 50% subsidy on buying crossbred cows/pigs, and free artificial insemination/vaccination.
eligibility: Livestock farmers and rural households in Sikkim holding CoI / Resident Proof
application_mode: Offline via District Animal Husbandry Officer / Local Dairy Cooperative Society

scheme_name: Sikkim Trout Culture & Cold-Water Fisheries Mission
description: Leverages cold freshwater mountain streams to promote high-value Rainbow Trout culture and carp farming in raceways and tanks.
benefits: 60% financial subsidy for constructing concrete trout raceways, purchasing high-quality trout ova/fingerlings, and specialized floating fish feed.
eligibility: Landholders and mountain farmers in Sikkim with access to perennial cold-water streams
application_mode: Offline via Directorate of Fisheries / District Fisheries Officer

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Off-Grid Solar Pumping Scheme (Sikkim Component)
description: Installs standalone solar-powered water pumpsets on remote mountain slopes where regular electricity grid connections are inaccessible.
benefits: Up to 85% combined central and state financial subsidy on standalone solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 5 HP).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Sikkim with access to surface water sources (springs/rivers) lacking electricity grid power
application_mode: Offline via SREDA (Sikkim Renewable Energy Development Agency) / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Sikkim Buckwheat & Traditional Crop Revival Scheme
description: Encourages cultivation of traditional climate-resilient crops like Buckwheat (Mithey/Titey Phaper), Finger Millet, and Native Beans to enhance nutritional security and soil health.
benefits: Free distribution of high-quality seeds, ₹10,000 per hectare incentive for traditional crop cultivation, and guaranteed state marketing support.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating indigenous crops in hill areas of Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via Block Agriculture Development Office

scheme_name: Terrace Land Development & Spring-Shed Rejuvenation Scheme
description: Provides financial and technical support for bench terracing, contour stone bunding, and recharging dried-up mountain springs (Dhars) for year-round agricultural water.
benefits: Financial grant up to ₹30,000 per hectare for bench terrace construction and spring-shed recharge structure building.
eligibility: Farmers practicing hill slope agriculture in Sikkim
application_mode: Offline via District Water Resources / Soil Conservation Department

scheme_name: Kalaignarin All Village Integrated Agricultural Development Programme
description: A comprehensive multi-departmental program targeting overall agricultural development at the Gram Panchayat level by converting fallow lands into cultivable land and creating water assets.
benefits: Free distribution of coconut saplings, horticulture kits, micro-irrigation grants, and community borewell installations.
eligibility: Farmers residing in selected focus Gram Panchayats across Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / Village Agricultural Extension Centers

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Solar Powered Pumpset Scheme
description: Provides standalone off-grid solar-powered irrigation pumpsets to replace diesel engines, ensuring uninterrupted daytime crop irrigation.
benefits: 70% state subsidy (30% Central + 40% State) on 5 HP, 7.5 HP, and 10 HP solar pumpsets; farmer pays remaining 30%.
eligibility: Farmers in Tamil Nadu with an active well/borewell water source
Must not have an existing TANGEDCO grid agricultural electricity connection
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / AED (Agricultural Engineering Dept)

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Millet Mission
description: Promotes cultivation and processing of major and minor millets (Ragi, Cholam, Kambu, Samai) across rainfed districts to tackle climate resilience and dietary health.
benefits: 100% subsidy on millet seed mini-kits, 50% subsidy on crop production inputs, and grants for establishing millet processing machinery.
eligibility: Farmers and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) cultivating millets in notified Tamil Nadu districts
application_mode: Uzhavan Mobile App / Local Block Agri Office

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Organic Farming Mission
description: Aimed at transforming chemical-intensive agricultural lands into chemical-free certified organic farms through training, bio-input production hubs, and certification support.
benefits: Financial aid of ₹10,000 per hectare for organic inputs, vermicompost unit setup, and free PGS/TNOCCA organic certification.
eligibility: Individual farmers or farmer clusters dedicated to converting land to organic practices
application_mode: Online via TNOCCA Portal / Uzhavan App

scheme_name: Chief Minister's Mannuyir Kaathu Mannuyir Kaapom Scheme
description: Focuses on rebuilding soil organic carbon and soil health by distributing green manure seeds, bio-fertilizers, and liquid bio-inoculants statewide.
benefits: 50% subsidy on green manure seeds (Daincha, Sunnhemp) and free distribution of bio-fertilizers/Trichoderma viride kits.
eligibility: All resident farmers holding agricultural land in Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Uzhavan App / Agricultural Extension Center (AEC)

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Agricultural Mechanization Scheme
description: Subsidizes high-cost agricultural machinery including power weeders, paddy transplanters, tractors, sugarcane harvesters, and brush cutters.
benefits: 40% subsidy for general category farmers and 50% subsidy for SC/ST, small, marginal, and women farmers.
eligibility: Resident farmers registered on the Uzhavan portal in Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / AED Portal

scheme_name: Kuruvai Paddy Special Package Scheme
description: A targeted seasonal package for Delta region farmers to maximize Kuruvai paddy production using certified seeds, fertilizers, and mechanized transplanting.
benefits: Full subsidy (100%) on certified paddy seeds, micronutrient mixtures, and chemical fertilizers for eligible acres.
eligibility: Paddy farmers in Cauvery Delta districts (Thanjavur, Tiruvarur, Nagapattinam, Mayiladuthurai, etc.)
application_mode: Uzhavan Mobile App / Local Agri Extension Officers

scheme_name: Periyar Ninaivu Samathuvapuram Horticulture Kit Distribution
description: Promotes household nutritional security by distributing rooftop vegetable gardening kits, fruit tree saplings, and high-yield seed packets to rural and semi-urban households.
benefits: 75% subsidized rooftop garden kits, fruit plants (Guava, Amla, Lemon), and vegetable seed mini-kits.
eligibility: Resident households, women, and small farmers across Tamil Nadu
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / Horticulture Department Outlets

scheme_name: Tamil Nadu Micro Irrigation Scheme (TANIDA / PMKSY)
description: Provides financial aid for installing drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to conserve water in sugarcane, banana, coconut, and vegetable crop fields.
benefits: 100% full subsidy for Small and Marginal farmers; 75% subsidy for other landholding farmers.
eligibility: Landholding farmers in Tamil Nadu with functional irrigation wells or canal access
application_mode: Uzhavan App / Micro Irrigation Information System (MIIS) Portal

scheme_name: State Protected Agricultural Zone (SPAZ) Sustainable Support
description: Provides special financial and input incentives to farmers in the Cauvery Delta region to preserve agricultural land from industrial encroachment and support pulse/oilseed cultivation.
benefits: Subsidized pulse seed kits, free soil health testing, and prioritized zero-interest seasonal crop loans.
eligibility: Farmers holding agricultural land within the designated Protected Agricultural Zone districts
application_mode: Online via Uzhavan App / Local Primary Agricultural Cooperative Societies (PACCS)

scheme_name: Rythu Bharosa
description: A direct cash transfer scheme providing seasonal financial assistance to landowning farmers to purchase critical agricultural inputs.
benefits: Direct cash transfer of ₹6,000 per acre per season (total ₹12,000/acre annually) deposited into bank accounts via DBT.
eligibility: Pattadar landowning farmers recorded in the official Dharani land management system of Telangana
application_mode: Automated DBT based on Dharani Database / Agriculture Officer Verification

scheme_name: Rythu Bima Scheme
description: A fully state-funded direct benefit life insurance scheme providing immediate financial support to families of deceased farmers.
benefits: ₹5,00,000 life insurance payout delivered to the nominee within 10 days in case of natural or accidental death of the farmer.
eligibility: Pattadar landholding farmers in Telangana aged 18 to 59 years recorded in Dharani
application_mode: Enrolled via Agricultural Extension Officers (AEO)

scheme_name: Free Power Supply for Agriculture (Telangana)
description: Provides round-the-clock free electrical power to agricultural pump sets, eliminating energy costs for farming operations.
benefits: 100% free, 24x7 high-quality electricity supply for agricultural pump sets.
eligibility: All agricultural electricity connection holders and pump set operators in Telangana
application_mode: Offline via TSSPDCL / TSNPDCL Local Discom Office

scheme_name: Rythu Runa Mafi (Crop Loan Waiver Scheme)
description: Relieves agricultural debt distress by waiving outstanding short-term crop loans disbursed by institutional banks.
benefits: Complete waiver of short-term institutional crop loans up to ₹2,00,000 per farmer family.
eligibility: Farmers holding short-term crop loans from commercial or cooperative banks meeting state cutoff criteria
documents: Crop Loan Account Details / Bank Passbook
application_mode: Direct Bank Settlement based on Department Verification Portal

scheme_name: Telangana Micro Irrigation Project (TMIP)
description: Subsidizes micro-irrigation installations to maximize crop yield per drop of water across semi-arid zones.
benefits: 100% subsidy for SC/ST farmers, 90% for small/marginal farmers, and 80% for general categories on drip and sprinkler setups.
eligibility: Farmers in Telangana owning land with an assured water source (borewell or canal)
application_mode: Online via TMIP Portal

scheme_name: Giri Vikas Scheme
description: Develops fallow lands of tribal farmers by fully funding water source extraction, power connectivity, and motor installation.
benefits: 100% state-funded drilling of borewells, installation of motor pumpsets, and power line extension for tribal agricultural lands.
eligibility: Small and marginal ST (Scheduled Tribe) farmers possessing RoFR or Pattadar passbooks in ITDA areas
application_mode: Offline via Integrated Tribal Development Agency (ITDA) / AEO

scheme_name: Sunna Vaddi Crop Loan Scheme (0% Interest Crop Loans)
description: Incentivizes timely bank loan repayment by reimbursing complete interest charges on short-term agricultural credit.
benefits: 100% interest subvention (0% effective interest rate) on crop loans up to ₹1,00,000 repaid within due dates.
eligibility: Farmers in Telangana who clear their short-term crop loans within the stipulated schedule
application_mode: Automatic Credit Transfer via Bank Branch

scheme_name: Telangana Oil Palm Mission
description: Encourages farmers to shift from paddy to oil palm cultivation to boost domestic edible oil production.
benefits: Up to 50%–70% financial subsidy on plant saplings, drip irrigation integration, inter-cropping support, and 4-year maintenance grants.
eligibility: Farmers in designated oil palm cultivation districts with guaranteed micro-irrigation facilities
application_mode: Online via Horticulture Department Telangana

scheme_name: Telangana Farm Mechanization Scheme
description: Assists farmers and Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) in acquiring machinery to modernize land preparation, planting, and harvesting.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on mini-tractors, paddy transplanters, rotavators, and combine harvesters.
eligibility: Individual farmers, CHCs, and farm worker groups registered in Telangana
application_mode: Online via Agritrans / Agri Department Portal

scheme_name: Telangana Sheep Rearing Scheme
description: Promotes economic self-reliance among traditional shepherd communities by subsidizing high-quality sheep units.
benefits: 75% state subsidy on sheep units (20 ewes + 1 ram) including free veterinary health cover and feed support.
eligibility: Members of Primary Sheep Cooperative Societies (PSCS) aged 18 and above in Telangana
application_mode: Offline via District Animal Husbandry Officer / PSCS

scheme_name: Mission Queen Pineapple Value Chain Development
description: A comprehensive convergence-led initiative designed to transform Tripura's GI-tagged 'Queen Pineapple' into a globally recognized brand by building end-to-end post-harvest infrastructure, cold chains, and market linkages.
benefits: Comprehensive value-chain support including planting material assistance, hub-and-spoke cold storage access, reefer logistics, organic certification, and direct buyer linkages.
eligibility: Pineapple cultivators, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and agricultural entrepreneurs in Tripura
application_mode: Online via Tripura Horticulture Portal / Offline through District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Tripura Rubber Plantation & Replanting Development Scheme
description: Provides financial and technical assistance for expanding new rubber plantations and rejuvenating old, senile rubber orchards across suitable hill tracts of Tripura.
benefits: Financial subsidies ranging up to 50% of development costs, distribution of high-yielding clonal saplings, and technical advisory support through the Rubber Board convergence.
eligibility: Small and marginal rubber growers, tribal farmers with land rights, and TTAADC beneficiaries in Tripura
documents: Land Patta / Forest Rights Act (RoFR) Land Document
application_mode: Offline via Rubber Board Regional Offices / Tripura Forest Development and Plantation Corporation (TFDPC)

scheme_name: Tripura True Potato Seed (TPS) & Hybrid Tuberlet Promotion Scheme
description: Leverages advanced True Potato Seed (TPS) and hybrid tuberlet technology developed at the State Horticulture Research Complex to produce disease-resistant, high-yield potato crops locally.
benefits: Subsidized distribution of hybrid potato seedling tubers, technical training on late-blight management, and cold-storage preservation assistance.
eligibility: Potato growers and cooperative farming groups registered with Tripura Horticulture Corporation Ltd (THCL)
application_mode: Offline via State Horticulture Research Complex, Nagicherra / Local Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Tripura Orange Cultivation & Hilly Floriculture Expansion Mission
description: Expands citrus (orange/mosambi) orchards into hilly terrains (Baramura, Jampui Hills, Sakhan Hills, Gomati) and promotes round-the-year commercial floriculture.
benefits: Subsidized sapling distribution, orchard rejuvenation grants (₹2,000 per hectare support for old orchards), and protected flower cultivation input kits.
eligibility: Farmers and tribal cultivators residing in hilly and designated horticultural zones of Tripura
application_mode: Online via Tripura Horticulture Portal / Offline through District Horticulture Officer

scheme_name: State Micro-Irrigation Scheme (MIDH Convergence - Tripura)
description: Promotes drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to maximize water use efficiency during dry spells for vegetable, fruit, and plantation crops.
benefits: Up to 50% to 80% capital subsidy on installation of drip and sprinkler irrigation systems, prioritized for small, marginal, and tribal farmers.
eligibility: Farmers in Tripura owning cultivable land with an assured water source
application_mode: Online via MIDH Portal / Offline through District Superintendent of Agriculture

scheme_name: Tripura Chief Minister's Krishi Protsahan & Input Subsidy Scheme
description: Provides essential agricultural inputs including certified high-yielding seeds, bio-fertilizers, and plant protection chemicals at heavily subsidized rates to boost staple food production.
benefits: 50% to 100% subsidy on seasonal seed minikits (paddy, pulses, oilseeds), bio-pesticides, and soil health card remedial inputs.
eligibility: All registered farmers, particularly small and marginal farmers across rural subdivisions of Tripura
application_mode: Offline via Block Agriculture Extension Office / Village Agriculture Worker (VLW)

scheme_name: Tripura Integrated Inland Fisheries & Aquaculture Development Scheme
description: Supports excavation of new fish ponds, renovation of derelict water bodies, Biofloc fish farming units, and free fish fingerling stocking in public and community reservoirs.
benefits: 40% to 60% subsidy on pond construction, fish feed, aerators, and 100% free distribution of fish fingerlings for community water bodies.
eligibility: Inland fish farmers, Matsyajibi Cooperative Societies, and rural households in Tripura
documents: Pond Ownership or Long-Term Lease Agreement
application_mode: Online via Tripura Fisheries Portal / Offline via District Superintendent of Fisheries

scheme_name: Tripura Animal Resource Development (ARDD) Backyard Poultry & Piggery Scheme
description: Enhances rural household incomes and nutritional standards by distributing subsidized high-yielding backyard poultry (Vanaraja/Giriraja) and piggery units.
benefits: Subsidized distribution of chick units, piglet breeding pairs, low-cost shelter construction assistance, and free vaccination camps.
eligibility: Rural families, women Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and BPL/tribal households in Tripura
application_mode: Offline via Local Veterinary Dispensary / District Animal Resource Development Office

scheme_name: Tripura Organic & Natural Farming Promotion Mission (PKVY Convergence)
description: Encourages chemical-free, eco-friendly farming practices by organizing farmer clusters, providing organic inputs, and facilitating Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare spread over 3 years for organic inputs, cluster formation, packaging, and branding of native organic produce.
eligibility: Farmers forming clusters of at least 20 hectares practicing or willing to adopt organic farming in Tripura
application_mode: Online via National Center for Organic Farming Portal / Offline through District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Tripura Agricultural Mechanization & Power Tiller Distribution Scheme
description: Overcomes labor shortages in hilly and wetland terrains by providing capital subsidies on power tillers, brush cutters, weeders, and small multi-crop threshers.
benefits: 40% to 50% subsidy on purchasing power tillers and farm machinery through Tripura Horticulture Corporation and Agriculture Department channels.
eligibility: Farmers and registered farming cooperatives holding land in Tripura
application_mode: Online via Agri DBT Portal / Offline through Block Agriculture Office

scheme_name: UP Krishi Yantra Subsidy Yojana
description: Offers financial assistance to farmers in Uttar Pradesh to purchase modern agricultural equipment such as laser land levelers, rotavators, tractors, seed drills, and power tillers.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on selected agricultural machinery (higher percentages apply to small, marginal, and SC/ST farmers).
eligibility: Resident farmers of Uttar Pradesh registered on the UP Agriculture Portal (Pardarshi Kisan Seva Yojana)
application_mode: Online via UP Agriculture Portal

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Kisan Sarvhit Bima Yojana
description: A comprehensive social security and insurance scheme that provides financial protection to agricultural families in UP against accidental death, permanent disability, and emergency medical costs.
benefits: Accidental death/disability coverage up to ₹5 Lakh, along with emergency hospitalization coverage up to ₹2.5 Lakh.
eligibility: Head of household/farmer residing in Uttar Pradesh aged 18 to 70 years
Annual family income below ₹75,000 or landless/marginal farmers
documents: Khasra/Khatauni (Land Record) or BPL Ration Card
application_mode: Online via UP Social Welfare Portal / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Khet Suraksha Yojana
description: Provides financial aid for installing low-voltage solar fencing around farm perimeters to protect standing crops from wild and stray animals without causing harm to animals.
benefits: Subsidy up to 60% (maximum ₹1.43 Lakh per hectare) for installing solar-powered crop protection fencing.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers of Uttar Pradesh
Available for individual or cluster farm plots
application_mode: Online via UP Agriculture Portal

scheme_name: UP Agris Scheme (Agricultural Resilient & Inclusive Systems)
description: A World Bank-assisted flagship initiative targeting climate resilience, crop diversification (pulses, oilseeds), seed sovereignty, and post-harvest supply chain development across Uttar Pradesh.
benefits: Direct subsidies on climate-resilient seed varieties, bio-pesticides, drip irrigation setups, and cold storage linkage grants.
eligibility: Farmers, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) operating in UP
documents: FPO Registration Certificate (if applying as FPO)
application_mode: Online / District Agriculture Extension Offices

scheme_name: Kisan Pathshala (Million Farmers School)
description: A statewide extension and capacity-building initiative conducted at the Gram Panchayat level to train farmers in modern cropping techniques, soil health management, natural farming, and government scheme awareness.
benefits: Free practical field training, soil testing kits, complimentary high-yield seed mini-kits, and direct connection with agricultural scientists.
eligibility: Open to all farmers residing in Uttar Pradesh
documents: Kisan Credit Card / UP Kisan Registration
application_mode: Direct participation at Village Panchayat Training Centers

scheme_name: PM-KUSUM Component-B (Solar Pump Scheme UP)
description: Encourages farmers to replace diesel irrigation pumps with eco-friendly solar-powered pumps, reducing operational costs and supporting sustainable irrigation.
benefits: 60% overall subsidy (30% Central + 30% State) on 2 HP, 3 HP, 5 HP, and 7.5 HP standalone solar pump installations.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with a valid water source (borewell/well)
Farmers who have not previously availed solar pump subsidies
application_mode: Online via UP Agriculture Portal (e-lottery mode)

scheme_name: UP Pulses and Oilseeds Mission
description: Designed to encourage crop diversification away from water-intensive rice-wheat cycles toward high-value pulses (Gram, Arhar, Urad) and oilseeds (Mustard, Groundnut).
benefits: Free certified seed mini-kits (up to 100% subsidy) and specialized bio-fertilizer packages.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers willing to allocate land for pulses and oilseed cultivation in notified districts
application_mode: Online portal registration / Local Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK)

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) - Crop & Livestock Loan UP
description: Provides short-term credit facilities at heavily subsidized interest rates to meet agricultural, animal husbandry, and dairy operational costs.
benefits: Institutional credit up to ₹3 Lakh (extended to ₹5 Lakh) at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum upon prompt repayment.
eligibility: Individual landowning farmers, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, oral lessees, and dairy/poultry farmers in UP
application_mode: Online via Banks / CSCs / Land Development Banks

scheme_name: UP Commercial Crop & Micro-Irrigation Subsidy
description: Promotes micro-irrigation systems (drip and sprinkler) specifically for sugarcane, horticulture, and commercial crops to improve water-use efficiency.
benefits: Subsidies ranging between 80% to 90% for small and marginal farmers on drip and sprinkler hardware installation.
eligibility: Farmers growing sugarcane, horticultural, or vegetable crops in Uttar Pradesh with available irrigation sources
application_mode: Online via UP Agriculture Portal

scheme_name: Pardarshi Kisan Seva Yojana (UP Farmer Registration)
description: The unified Single-Sign-On portal for Uttar Pradesh farmers that links all state and central agricultural subsidies (seeds, fertilizers, machinery, solar) directly to their bank accounts.
benefits: Single window access to all state farm schemes and direct benefit transfers without intermediary deductions.
eligibility: All resident agricultural landholders in Uttar Pradesh
application_mode: Online via Portal or nearest CSC / Jan Seva Kendra

scheme_name: Deendayal Upadhyaya Sahakarita Kisan Kalyan Yojana
description: Provides interest-free loans to small, marginal, and hill farmers to purchase agri-inputs, farm machinery, and establish allied agricultural enterprises like dairy, poultry, and horticulture.
benefits: Interest-free crop and agri-loans up to ₹3,00,000 for individual farmers and up to ₹5,00,000 for Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) and Self-Help Groups (SHGs).
eligibility: Small, marginal, and hill farmers residing in Uttarakhand
Must be members of Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS) or cooperative banks in Uttarakhand
application_mode: Offline via District Cooperative Bank Branches / PACS / Local Agriculture Extension Officer

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Apple Mission & High-Density Plantation Scheme
description: Promotes high-density apple orchards using imported clonal rootstocks to modernize hill horticulture and significantly increase fruit productivity per unit area.
benefits: Up to 80% capital subsidy on purchasing high-density apple saplings, anti-hail nets, drip irrigation systems, and trellis support structures.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in hill districts of Uttarakhand located at suitable altitudes for apple cultivation (above 5,000 feet)
documents: Altitude Verification / Land Suitability Certificate from Horticulture Dept
application_mode: Online via Uttarakhand Horticulture Portal / Offline through Chief Horticulture Officer (CHO)

scheme_name: Chief Minister State Aromatic Plant Mission (Aroma Valley Scheme)
description: Encourages cultivation of wild-animal-resistant aromatic plants (Damask Rose, Lemongrass, Cinnamon, Lavender, Mint) to prevent crop damage by wildlife and utilize abandoned hill terraces.
benefits: Free supply of high-yielding aromatic planting material, 50% subsidy on installing essential oil distillation units, and guaranteed buyback through CAP (Centre for Aromatic Plants).
eligibility: Farmers, landholders, and cluster groups in hill districts of Uttarakhand
application_mode: Offline via Centre for Aromatic Plants (CAP), Selaqui, Dehradun / District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Polyhouse Yojana
description: Supports construction of modern naturally ventilated polyhouses across hill blocks for off-season vegetable cultivation and floriculture to boost hill farm incomes.
benefits: 80% capital subsidy for installing polyhouse structures up to 100 sq. meters to 500 sq. meters, along with subsidised high-yielding vegetable seeds and drip kits.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers residing in Uttarakhand holding suitable terraced agricultural land
application_mode: Online via Uttarakhand Horticulture Portal (shm.uk.gov.in) / District Horticulture Office

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Climate Responsive Rainfed Farming Project (UDRP - Climate Smart Agriculture)
description: A World Bank-assisted project focusing on soil moisture conservation, water harvesting ponds, spring-shed rejuvenation, and drought-tolerant seed adoption across rainfed hill watersheds.
benefits: Grants for constructing plastic-lined farm ponds (poly-tanks), bench terracing, soil health restoration, and distribution of climate-resilient millet/pulse minikits.
eligibility: Farmers residing in selected micro-watershed development blocks across Uttarakhand hill districts
application_mode: Offline via Watershed Management Directorate (WMD) / Gram Panchayat Development Officer

scheme_name: Millet Mission Uttarakhand (House Crowning / House-Hold Millet Scheme)
description: Promotes production, processing, and procurement of indigenous hill millets (Mandua / Finger Millet, Jhangora / Barnyard Millet) at Guaranteed Minimum Support Prices.
benefits: Direct cash incentive of ₹1,500 per acre for millet cultivators, guaranteed government procurement at remunerative prices, and free certified millet seeds.
eligibility: Farmers cultivating indigenous millets in designated hill blocks of Uttarakhand
application_mode: Online via Agri Portal / Offline through Local Agriculture Extension Officer (AEO)

scheme_name: Chief Minister Solar Pump Scheme (PM-KUSUM Uttarakhand)
description: Installs solar water pumpsets (2 HP to 7.5 HP) on hill terraces and valley lands where electricity grid lines are difficult to extend.
benefits: Up to 80% to 90% combined Central and State financial subsidy on standalone solar water pumping systems.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Uttarakhand with access to surface water streams, wells, or ponds without grid power
documents: Self-Declaration of No Existing Electric Connection
application_mode: Online via UREDA Portal (ureda.uk.gov.in) / District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: Mukhyamantri Anchal Amrit Yojana & Dairy Development Scheme
description: Promotes high-yielding dairy cattle rearing, milk co-operatives formation, modern cattle sheds, and chaff cutters across hill and plain districts.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy on purchasing crossbred cows/badri cows, 75% subsidy on chaff cutters, and ₹4 per liter bonus on milk supplied to dairy cooperatives.
eligibility: Dairy farmers and members of Anchal Dairy Cooperative Societies in Uttarakhand
application_mode: Offline via Local Dairy Development Officer / Anchal Milk Union Centre

scheme_name: Uttarakhand Cold-Water Fisheries & Trout Racing Mission
description: Utilizes perennial mountain streams to construct concrete raceways for commercial culture of high-value Rainbow Trout fish.
benefits: 60% subsidy for SC/ST/Women and 40% for General beneficiaries on raceway construction, trout feed, and disease-free trout seed.
eligibility: Individual landholders and fishermen in hill districts with perennial cold-water stream access
application_mode: Offline via District Fisheries Officer (DFO) / Directorate of Fisheries, Dehradun

scheme_name: Hill Farm Machinery & Power Tiller Subsidy Scheme (SMAM Uttarakhand)
description: Subsidizes specialized light-weight agricultural machinery designed for narrow mountain terraces, including power tillers, brush cutters, weeders, and mini-threshers.
benefits: 50% to 80% subsidy on hill-friendly farm equipment for individual farmers and up to 80% for Custom Hiring Centers operated by SHGs/Cooperatives.
eligibility: Farmers owning land in Uttarakhand hill districts registered on the Agmachinery portal
application_mode: Online via Agmachinery Portal / District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Krishak Bandhu (Kamiya)
description: Provides dual benefits of annual crop investment support and life insurance coverage to farmers and sharecroppers across West Bengal.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹10,000/year (minimum ₹4,000/year for small holdings) in two installments, plus ₹2,00,000 death benefit insurance cover.
eligibility: Landowning farmers and registered sharecroppers (Bargadars) in West Bengal aged 18 to 60 years
documents: RoR / Khatian Copy / Barga Registration Certificate
application_mode: Online via Krishak Bandhu Portal / Duare Sarkar Camps

scheme_name: Bangla Shasya Bima (BSB)
description: A state-sponsored crop insurance program covering crop loss due to adverse weather events with no premium cost for farmers.
benefits: 100% premium cost borne by the West Bengal government for all notified food and oilseed crops; direct financial compensation for loss.
eligibility: All farmers (owner-cultivators, sharecroppers, and tenant farmers) cultivating notified crops in West Bengal
documents: Sowing Certificate from local Krishi Prajukti Sahayak (KPS)
application_mode: Online via BSB Portal / Block Development Office

scheme_name: West Bengal Farm Mechanization Scheme (FSM)
description: Offers subsidies for purchasing small equipment, power tillers, and setting up Custom Hiring Centers (CHCs) to encourage mechanized farming.
benefits: 50% to 60% subsidy (up to ₹3,00,000) for machinery and up to 40% grant (up to ₹10,00,000) for CHC establishment.
eligibility: Individual farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and SHGs registered on the Matir Katha portal
application_mode: Online via Matir Katha Portal

scheme_name: Matir Srishti Scheme
description: Transforms barren and red-laterite soil lands across western districts into productive horticulture and animal husbandry hubs.
benefits: Free distribution of fruit saplings, soil conditioning support, drip irrigation installation, and micro-credit access.
eligibility: Farmers owning underutilized or barren land in Bankura, Purulia, Jhargram, Birbhum, and Paschim Medinipur
application_mode: Offline via Block Development Office (BDO) / Duare Sarkar

scheme_name: Amar Fasal Amar Gola
description: Provides financial support to build post-harvest storage structures like low-cost grain stores, onion storage units, and seed stores.
benefits: Financial subsidy ranging from ₹5,000 to ₹25,000 depending on the type and storage capacity of the structure built.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers holding registered agricultural land in West Bengal
application_mode: Offline via Assistant Director of Agriculture (ADA) Block Office

scheme_name: Jal Dharo Jal Bharo
description: Promotes rainwater harvesting and farm-pond creation to ensure year-round irrigation availability for agricultural lands.
benefits: 100% state funding or direct assistance up to ₹1,50,000 for digging dedicated farm ponds and water retention tanks.
eligibility: Farmers and landowners in West Bengal with suitable land for pond excavation
application_mode: Offline via Water Resources Investigation & Development Department

scheme_name: Sufal Bangla Infrastructure & Market Linkage
description: Facilitates direct sales of farm produce from growers to urban consumers through state-managed retail outlets and mobile vans.
benefits: Direct procurement at fair prices, eliminating middleman commissions; subsidies on mobile vending vehicles for FPOs.
eligibility: Farmers, Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs), and Self-Help Groups (SHGs) in West Bengal
documents: Farmer Registration ID / FPO Registration Certificate
application_mode: Online / Offline via Sufal Bangla Project Management Unit

scheme_name: West Bengal Cattle & Livestock Distribution Scheme
description: Distributes high-yielding milch cows, goats, and poultry to rural farming families to supplement farm income.
benefits: Up to 80% to 100% subsidized distribution of livestock units and free veterinary health support.
eligibility: Small, marginal, and landless agricultural laborers in West Bengal with preference given to women
application_mode: Offline via Block Livestock Development Officer (BLDO)

scheme_name: State Tea Garden Workers & Small Tea Growers Assistance
description: Provides specialized input incentives, green leaf price protection, and equipment support to small tea growers (STGs) in North Bengal.
benefits: Subsidized fertilizers, tea pruning tools, and financial grants for organic certification.
eligibility: Small tea growers holding land up to 10.12 hectares registered with the Tea Board / WB Agri Department
documents: Tea Board / Small Tea Grower Registration
application_mode: Offline via District Agricultural Office (North Bengal Districts)

scheme_name: State Inland Fisheries & Pisciculture Support
description: Offers assistance for fish pond re-excavation, supply of high-quality fingerlings, and fish feed to small scale aquaculture farmers.
benefits: 50% financial subsidy on input purchases (fish seed/feed) and technical aid for brackish and freshwater fish farming.
eligibility: Fish farmers, fishers' cooperatives, and pond owners/lessees in West Bengal
documents: Pond Ownership Record or Lease Agreement
application_mode: Offline via Assistant Director of Fisheries (ADF) at Block Level

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A Central Sector scheme that provides direct direct income support to all landholding farmer families across India to meet crop input and domestic needs.
benefits: ₹6,000 per year provided in three equal installments of ₹2,000 every four months directly into the beneficiary's bank account via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Landholding farmer families with cultivable land registered in their name.
Excludes institutional landholders, high-income taxpayers, government employees, and constitutional post holders.
documents: Land Ownership Record (Khatauni / Land Mutation Certificate)
application_mode: Online via PM-KISAN portal or offline via Common Service Center (CSC) / State Nodal Officer

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: Comprehensive yield-based crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks, drought, floods, pests, and post-harvest losses.
benefits: Nominal premium rates paid by farmers: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for Annual Commercial/Horticultural crops. Remaining premium is subsidized by Central and State Governments.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers, tenant farmers, and owner-cultivators growing notified crops in notified areas.
application_mode: Online via National Crop Insurance Portal (NCIP), Banks, or CSCs

scheme_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
description: Provides single-window institutional credit to farmers for agricultural production, post-harvest expenses, animal husbandry, and fisheries at highly subsidized interest rates.
benefits: Short-term crop loans up to ₹3 Lakh at an effective interest rate of 4% per annum (after 3% prompt repayment incentive). No collateral required for loans up to ₹1.6 Lakh.
eligibility: Individual/joint landholders, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, Self-Help Groups (SHGs), and Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) engaged in agriculture or allied activities.
documents: Identity Proof & Address Proof (Aadhaar / Voter ID)
Land Ownership Documents / Crop Pattern Proof
application_mode: Offline/Online via Commercial Banks, Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), or Cooperative Banks

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
description: Focuses on micro-irrigation technologies like drip and sprinkler systems to improve water-use efficiency on farms, reduce pumping costs, and boost crop productivity.
benefits: 55% financial subsidy on micro-irrigation equipment for Small and Marginal Farmers, and 45% subsidy for other farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning agricultural land with an assured water source.
Members of Water User Associations and Self-Help Groups.
application_mode: Online/Offline through State Agriculture / Micro-Irrigation Departments

scheme_name: Agriculture Infrastructure Fund (AIF)
description: A medium-to-long term debt financing facility for creating post-harvest management infrastructure, cold chains, silos, assaying units, and community farming assets.
benefits: 3% interest subvention per annum on loans up to ₹2 Crore for a maximum period of 7 years, along with credit guarantee coverage under CGTMSE.
eligibility: Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), FPOs, Agri-entrepreneurs, Startups, SHGs, and Individual Farmers.
documents: KYC and Financial Credentials of the Applicant / Entity
application_mode: Online via National Agriculture Infrastructure Fund Portal

scheme_name: Soil Health Card (SHC) Scheme
description: Integrated now under Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana (RKVY), this initiative tests farm soil chemistry to give farmers customized recommendations on nutrient dosages and organic amendments.
benefits: Free soil sample testing and issuance of a personalized Soil Health Card every 3 years containing nutrient status (12 parameters) and tailored fertilizer dosage advice.
eligibility: All farmers cultivating agricultural land across India.
application_mode: Offline soil collection through State Soil Testing Laboratories / Village Agriculture Extension Officers

scheme_name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana (PKVY)
description: Promotes chemical-free organic farming through cluster-based approaches, Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) certification, and marketing support.
benefits: Financial assistance of ₹50,000 per hectare over 3 years, of which ₹31,000 is directly provided for organic inputs (seeds, bio-fertilizers, bio-pesticides).
eligibility: Farmers forming groups/clusters of 50 or more having 50 acres of land in total.
Individual farmers adopting organic farming under certified clusters.
application_mode: Offline/Online via Regional Council under PGS-India / District Agriculture Officer

scheme_name: National Mission on Natural Farming (NMNF)
description: Supports livestock-centric, zero-chemical natural farming (Bhartiya Prakritik Krishi Paddhati) to cut input costs, restore soil organic carbon, and reduce environmental degradation.
benefits: ₹15,000 per hectare financial incentive over 3 years for adopting natural farming inputs, establishing Bio-Input Resource Centres (BHRCs), and field demonstrations.
eligibility: All landholding farmers willing to transition from chemical to natural farming.
application_mode: Online via NMNF Portal or through District Agriculture Office

scheme_name: Sub-Mission on Agricultural Mechanization (SMAM)
description: Increases farm power availability and mechanization among small and marginal farmers by subsidizing agricultural machinery and establishing Custom Hiring Centres (CHCs).
benefits: 40% to 80% subsidy on procurement of tractors, power tillers, rotavators, combine harvesters, and up to 80% capital subsidy for establishing CHCs.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers, SC/ST, women farmers, cooperative societies, and FPOs.
application_mode: Online via Direct Benefit Transfer in Agricultural Mechanization portal

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Maandhan Yojana (PM-KMY)
description: A voluntary and contributory pension scheme designed to provide old-age social security to small and marginal farmers when they reach 60 years of age.
benefits: Assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon reaching the age of 60 years. Central Government matches monthly contributions made by the farmer (₹55 to ₹200/month based on entry age).
eligibility: Small and marginal farmers owning up to 2 hectares of cultivable land.
Age group between 18 and 40 years.
documents: Savings Bank Account / PM-KISAN Account Details
application_mode: Offline via Common Service Centres (CSC) or online self-enrollment

scheme_name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
description: A pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities.
benefits: Transparent real-time online bidding, quality assaying support, access to broader buyer markets across India, and direct bank payout without intermediary deductions.
eligibility: All farmers, traders, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs) registered with participating APMC mandis.
documents: Local APMC Registration / Trader License (if applicable)
application_mode: Online via e-NAM portal or mobile app

scheme_name: Mission for Integrated Development of Horticulture (MIDH)
description: A scheme driving holistic growth of the horticulture sector covering fruits, vegetables, root/tuber crops, mushrooms, spices, aromatic plants, and flowers.
benefits: 40% to 80% subsidy for setting up polyhouses/greenhouses, drip irrigation, pack houses, cold storage facilities, and high-quality sapling nurseries.
eligibility: Individual horticulturists, farmer groups, SHGs, and commercial horticulture units.
application_mode: Offline/Online through State Horticulture Mission (SHM) offices

scheme_name: Formation and Promotion of 10,000 Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs)
description: Focuses on mobilizing farmers into FPOs to achieve economies of scale, improve bargaining power, access credit, and gain direct market linkages.
benefits: Financial matching equity grant up to ₹2,000 per member (max ₹15 Lakh per FPO) along with credit guarantee cover up to ₹2 Crore per FPO.
eligibility: Groups of minimum 300 farmers in plain areas or 100 farmers in Hilly/North-Eastern regions formed as FPOs.
documents: FPO Registration Certificate (Companies Act / Cooperative Societies Act)
Board of Directors' Aadhaar & PAN details
application_mode: Online submission through Implementing Agencies (NABARD, SFAC, NCDC)

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Annadata Aay Sanrakshan Abhiyan (PM-AASHA)
description: An umbrella scheme ensuring farmers receive fair MSP prices for pulses, oilseeds, and copra through direct physical procurement and price shortfall payment systems.
benefits: Protects farmers from market distress sales by assuring procurement at MSP (Price Support Scheme) or compensating the difference between market price and MSP (Price Deficiency Payment Scheme).
eligibility: All growers producing notified pulses, oilseeds, and oil palm crops registered on procurement portals.
application_mode: Online registration at designated procurement centers / e-Samridhi portal before harvest season

scheme_name: Namo Drone Didi Scheme
description: Equips Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) with agricultural drones to provide rental liquid fertilizer and pesticide spraying services to local farmers.
benefits: 80% financial subsidy (up to ₹8 Lakh) provided to Women SHGs for purchasing agricultural drone packages, along with comprehensive drone pilot training.
eligibility: Active Women Self-Help Groups (SHGs) under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - NRLM.
Selected SHG members meeting basic educational criteria for drone pilot licensing.
documents: Aadhaar Card of selected SHG Drone Pilot
SHG Registration Proof & Joint Bank Account
application_mode: Offline via State Rural Livelihood Mission (SRLM) Block Offices

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Matsya Sampada Yojana (PMMSY)
description: A flagship scheme aimed at driving sustainable development of the fisheries sector through modernization, bio-floc aquaculture, deep-sea fishing craft, and cold chain logistics.
benefits: Capital subsidy of 40% for General category beneficiaries and 60% for SC/ST/Women for fish culture, bio-floc units, cages, motorized boats, and refrigerated vehicles.
eligibility: Fishers, fish farmers, fish workers, fisheries cooperatives, and women fish vendors.
documents: Fisherman ID Card / Land or Water Body Lease Document
application_mode: Online via PMMSY portal or offline via District Fisheries Office

scheme_name: National Beekeeping & Honey Mission (NBHM)
description: Promotes scientific beekeeping to boost crop pollination, increase agricultural yields, and support honey and beehive product processing.
benefits: Up to 80% subsidy for procurement of bee boxes, bee colonies, honey extraction equipment, testing laboratories, and custom processing units.
eligibility: Individual farmers, landless agricultural workers, beekeepers, and beekeeper SHGs/FPOs.
application_mode: Online via Madhukranti Beekeeping Registration Portal / National Bee Board

scheme_name: Rashtriya Gokul Mission (RGM)
description: Focuses on genetic upgradation of bovine population, conservation of indigenous bovine breeds, and increasing milk productivity through artificial insemination.
benefits: Subsidy of up to 50% (max ₹2 Crore) for setting up breed multiplication farms, free nationwide artificial insemination (NAIP) services, and sex-sorted semen assistance.
eligibility: Individual dairy entrepreneurs, FPOs, SHGs, and Section 8 companies engaged in cattle breeding.
documents: Land Ownership / Lease Documents for Dairy Farm
application_mode: Online through NLM / RGM Application Portal

scheme_name: National Mission on Edible Oils - Oil Palm (NMEO-OP)
description: Promotes oil palm cultivation to expand coverage, reduce national import dependency on edible oils, and provide price viability guarantees to growers.
benefits: ₹29,000 per hectare assistance for planting material, ₹5,000/ha/year for maintenance inputs, and a Formula Price guarantee mechanism for fresh fruit bunches (FFBs).
eligibility: Farmers owning land in notified oil palm potential districts across India.
application_mode: Offline/Online via State Agriculture/Horticulture Department

scheme_name: PM Dhan-Dhaanya Krishi Yojana
description: A focused national scheme launched to fast-track modern agricultural practices, crop diversification, and productivity enhancements across 100 high-potential agrarian districts.
benefits: Targeted funding allocations for soil health enhancement, localized cold storage units, quality seed distribution, and integrated pest management.
eligibility: Farmers operating within designated agricultural districts under the Dhan-Dhaanya program framework.
application_mode: Offline via District Agriculture Mission / Krishi Vigyan Kendras (KVKs)
